tracks.title: 8bit Dungeon Boss
tracks.description: A sort of square swing piece using very simple synths (but highly post-processed). It just makes you want to explore that dungeon, doesn't it!? 8bit Dungeon Level is similar but slower.

tracks.title: 8bit Dungeon Level
tracks.description: A sort of square swing piece using very simple synths (but highly post-processed). It just makes you want to explore that dungeon, doesn't it!? 8bit Dungeon Boss is similar but faster.

tracks.title: A Mission
tracks.description: Highly orchestrated pulsing piece. High energy. Driven by strings and some low brass.

tracks.title: A Singular Perversion
tracks.description: Overplayed piano, subtle percussion, sweepy violins.

tracks.title: A Very Brady Special
tracks.description: The Brady in the title is not a reference to the Brady Bunch. It is a reference to Dr. Brady Haran, one of the most influential filmmakers of all time.

tracks.title: Accralate
tracks.description: African-inspired lazy drum ensemble. Feel change in the middle; Tempo change near the end. Lots of polyrhythms. This piece exhibits some phantom notes athat you hear, but don't really exist. Hard to explain. Batu, Conga, Marimba, Agogo, Cowbell, Clave.

tracks.title: Aces High
tracks.description: Like a night out on the Vegas strip, Aces High makes your hips swagger with a playful bass line and staccato electric guitar. An organ plays the main theme, but when the song changes to a minor key, a clavichord plucks out the central melody, before returning to the slippery organ refrain.

tracks.title: Achaidh Cheide
tracks.description: Traditional Irish-sounding. I had a hard time classifying this in my existing feels. It feels like Irish folk music.

tracks.title: Achilles
tracks.instruments: French Horns, Trumpets, Trombones, Percussion, Strings
tracks.description: Written as theme music for an epic drama. This starts broad and kicks into awesome at 0:27.

tracks.title: Acid Trumpet
tracks.description: Cool EP, muted trumpet, and a layed back bass.

tracks.title: Action
tracks.description: Underscore for a very dramatic scene with lots of cut-outs for dialog. Tubular bells, snare, tymp, etc are all at the fore. Might be difficult to use generically, but it is quite a good cue.

tracks.title: Adding the Sun
tracks.description: Energizing and uplifting!

tracks.title: Adeste Fideles (Shorter)
tracks.description: We start with a repeating music box theme. The cello recontextualizes the simple music boxes providing a surprising and comforting bed for the low trumpet to sing over. [/musicologist ramblings] HELLO, HOLIDAY DANCE RECITALS!  There is a shorter version of this available... because holiday dance recitals.

tracks.title: Adeste Fideles Waltz
tracks.description: We start with a repeating music box theme. The cello recontextualizes the simple music boxes providing a surprising and comforting bed for the low trumpet to sing over. [/musicologist ramblings] HELLO, HOLIDAY DANCE RECITALS!  There is a shorter version of this available... because holiday dance recitals.

tracks.title: Adventure Meme
tracks.description: It came from the GameBoy! Classic adventure style video game music in awesome style! Grab your sword! An Adventure Meme awaits!

tracks.title: Adventures in Adventureland
tracks.instruments: Harp, Bassoon, Glockenspiel, Percussion, Clarinet, Flutes, Cellos, Basses, Violas, Violins, French Horns, Marimba, Trombones, Bells, Tuba, Trumpets
tracks.description: You have taken charge of your destiny.  You have trained for this.  You have power and purpose. You have arrived at the Elite Five Challenge!! #symphonic #cartoony #adventure #comfyshorts

tracks.title: Aerosol of my Love
tracks.description: The title of this piece of music is a pun. The word "Aerosol" is a reference to a common hair product delivery method of the 1980s. "Aerosol" can very easily sound like the words "Here is all" or even "There is all".  One can effectively hear the title spoken out loud as "Here is all of my Love". But they would be wrong.   I don't like the usage of aerosols in applications where there are other delivery methods available. #ClawBangs

tracks.title: Aftermath
tracks.description: This is a dark, almost inky feel - subtle, and texturally rich.

tracks.title: Aggressor
tracks.instruments: Drums, Violins, Violas, Cellos, Basses, Tubas, Trombones, French Horns, Cimbasso, Trumpet, Xylophone.
tracks.description: The whole Orchestral Speed Metal genre has been done to death. But you can't consider yourself a real composer if you haven't checked "Orchestral Speed Metal" off your list. Other essential genres include: Electro Emo-Pop, Motet, Disco Noise, Adult Contemporary, Tone Poem, Haircore, and Zydeco Revival.

tracks.title: Agnus Dei X
tracks.description: Just a quick piece from a traditional Latin mass. Lyrics are "Agnus Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi, miserere nobis._. Agnus Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi, dona nobis pacem". For Sopranos and Bass.

tracks.title: AhDah
tracks.description: A tight slightly funky EP and drum machine driven piece featuring female voice.

tracks.title: Air Prelude
tracks.description: Slow; lots of flutes; some digital synth for texture.

tracks.title: Airport Lounge
tracks.description: Light and airy, this piece is guaranteed not to steal focus.

tracks.title: Airship Serenity
tracks.description: This is the first slow 8-bit piece I ever tried. There was some skepticism going in, but holy man! This turned out great! You can use it for your game credits, or more chill parts of your game. Maybe at the Healing Shack, or the Abe Vigoda Memorial Pagoda and Koi Pond. The uncompressed download has a bonus  percussion track.

tracks.title: Aitech
tracks.description: Hard rock beat with electronic elements grooving in.

tracks.title: Alchemists Tower
tracks.description: A crazy ride, starting calm and erupting into a frenzy. Calm again at the end. Very Elfman-like.

tracks.title: Alien Restaurant
tracks.description: Non-real instrumentation written as background music for a restaurant on another planet. Tribal, primitive, evolved. 4-tone scale.

tracks.title: All This
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Cellos, Violins, Basses, French Horn, Trombones, Tuba, Flute
tracks.description: Slow-building piece in 7-4 time.

tracks.title: Allada
tracks.description: Loose feeling West African rhythm with continuously phasing marimbas, and a short djembe solo in the middle.

tracks.title: Almost Bliss
tracks.description: I love sipping lemonade by the lake when a storm approaches. I love walking through apple orchards in the fall.  I love the squeak of minivan tires being dragged onto the flatbed truck of the repo man. Memories of simpler times... so wonderful.

tracks.title: Almost in F
tracks.description: Very long, very slow, trance-inducing piece... 36 cents sharp of the key of F. Yes, there is a good reason for that. No, I'm not going to explain it.

tracks.title: Almost New
tracks.description: Remember when you went on summer holiday to your Auntie's house outside Nether Wallop in Hampshire while your parents went to Cyprus to broker a secret deal with the Ottoman Empire?  Remember the times in the Magic Garden? This piece of music is more "Magic Garden" than "Inter-Empire Diplomacy".

tracks.title: Amazing Grace 2011
tracks.description: Tasteful version of the classic religious piece.

tracks.title: Amazing Plan
tracks.description: With elements of a quick Russian polka playing in the immigrant section of industrial-era New York City, this piece is mainly in a minor key, but at the halfway point changes to a major key, reversing the feel and tone for a few seconds, before reverting to the darkness of the minor key.

tracks.title: Amazing Plan - Distressed
tracks.description: With elements of a quick Russian polka playing in the immigrant section of industrial-era New York City, this piece is mainly in a minor key, but at the halfway point changes to a major key, reversing the feel and tone for a few seconds, before reverting to the darkness of the minor key.

tracks.title: Ambiment
tracks.description: Slow sonorous texture punctuated with soft piano in mostly consonant tones. There is enough dissonance to keep the mind engaged over its length.

tracks.title: Ambler
tracks.description: Mid-90s styled happy happy video game music.

tracks.title: Ambush
tracks.description: Dark curling undercurrent in winds and strings that breaks into cymbals at climax.

tracks.title: Americana
tracks.instruments: Cellos, Bass Clarinet, Alto Flute, English Horn, Clarinet. French Horns, Trombones, Tubas, Percussion, Celesta, Violins, Basses
tracks.description: Starts out simply on the plains with cellos and winds, becomes disrupted bit a bit and piles on the grandiose with a lot of brass!

tracks.title: An Upsetting Theme
tracks.description: Double Basses and glockenspiel - with some cellos thrown in. Dark, dark, dark! This bit got removed from a soundtrack I recorded. I still like it!

tracks.title: Anachronist
tracks.description: Heavy rock sound... with a harpsichord as well. Unlike most of my music - this one it perfectly titled.

tracks.title: Anamalie
tracks.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Piano, Percussion, Clarinets, English Horn
tracks.description: Is this a Western? No idea. Super laid-back piece with a crazy subtle modulation at 1:06. Yeah. That happened. Slow, beautiful. The download comes with a slightly faster bonus version.

tracks.title: Ancient Mystery Waltz (Allegro)
tracks.description: Whilst out walking and practicing the waltz down my block, this was the song that was going through my head. It isn't super-waltzy sounding, but it is super easy to waltz to. Comes in 3 varieties, Chill, Spritely, and HANG ON, THIS IS VIENNESE!!!

tracks.title: Ancient Mystery Waltz (Presto)
tracks.description: Whilst out walking and practicing the waltz down my block, this was the song that was going through my head. It isn't super-waltzy sounding, but it is super easy to waltz to. Comes in 3 varieties, Chill, Spritely, and HANG ON, THIS IS VIENNESE!!!

tracks.title: Ancient Mystery Waltz (Vivace)
tracks.description: Whilst out walking and practicing the waltz down my block, this was the song that was going through my head. It isn't super-waltzy sounding, but it is super easy to waltz to. Comes in 3 varieties, Chill, Spritely, and HANG ON, THIS IS VIENNESE!!!

tracks.title: Ancient Rite
tracks.description: A solumn affair. Deep and religious.

tracks.title: Ancient Winds
tracks.description: So, you want to relax, huh buddy? Do ya? You want to RELAX? Me too. Here's some beautiful sounds to listen to.

tracks.title: And Awaken
tracks.description: Sweet sounding French horns opposite clarinet with harps.

tracks.title: Andreas Theme
tracks.instruments: EP, Drums, Bass, Gemshorn, Ocarina, Synth, Percussion
tracks.description: This is my favorite piece that perfectly captures a slightly grown-up sound, but still sounds like a 1990s-era action-drama.  Old Way: Synthesized Electric Piano New Way: Actual EP Recordings that are built into virtual instruments that are then put through a lot of processors to make them SOUND like Synthesized Electric Pianos. Old Way: Synthesized Ocarina New Way: Assemble recordings of an ocarina player, and then make a virtual instrument that captures beautiful expression and legato lines... turn off all that fancy stuff and play it like a crappy synth.

tracks.title: Android Sock Hop
tracks.description: This has a couple funny-sounding synths and plenty of whitespace. As a note to YouTube "producers"; 10 hours of this piece would be pretty mean. 1 hour of this piece isn't much better. For the sake of mankind, please do not make extended mixes of this piece. I can not be held responsible for mental anguish caused by repeated listening.

tracks.title: Angel Share
tracks.description: Starts slow and builds to an ecstasy the likes of which are almost guaranteed to garner donations from your flock! Bonus track comes with a everything except the drums in case you need a smoother feel.

tracks.title: Angels We Have Heard on High
Angels We Have Heard on High
tracks.description: Slow and mellow.

tracks.title: Angevin
tracks.description: Sort of a slow Renaissance like piece of music.

tracks.title: Angevin B
tracks.description: Faster Renaissance like piece of music. Also available in a very slow version.

tracks.title: AngloZulu
tracks.instruments: Percussion, English Horn, Choir, Brass, Strings, Flute
tracks.description: A collision of musical traditions put together in an epic theme.

tracks.title: Anguish
tracks.description: You want contemplative!? You GOT contemplative!

tracks.title: Anxiety
tracks.description: Background horror music. Electronic.

tracks.title: Apero Hour
tracks.description: Cool jazz. I'm going to warn you now, that organ line gets stuck in your head really easily... like an icepick in a Marxist revolutionary. Too soon?

tracks.title: Apprehension
tracks.description: Background horror music. Electronic. Sparse and grating.

tracks.title: Aquarium
tracks.instruments: Flute, Pianos, Glockenspiel, Violins, Violas, Cellos
tracks.description: Saint-Saens' masterpiece. This piece is 100% free to use. It will probably get claimed by any number of music publishers, just so you know. They can't tell the difference between this and their copyrighted recordings. Contest the claims. Contest all the claims. I do not claim music.

tracks.title: Arcadia
tracks.feel: Eerie, Epic, Mysterious, Mystical, Unnerving, Uplifting
tracks.description: Many choirs in a slow-moving ethereal progression.

tracks.title: Arcane
tracks.description: Nicely motive tribal/modern percussive fusion.

tracks.title: Aretes
tracks.description: Solo piano surrounded by rich textures.

tracks.title: Arid Foothills
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Marimba, Basses, Trombones, Tuba, French Horn
tracks.description: Slight polyrhythms grow in the piece as it gains intensity. It eases back down at 2:30.

tracks.title: Arroz Con Pollo
tracks.description: When I think of Cuba, I think of one thing; Nickel mines! Moa, Cuba (aka "The Sudbury of the Caribbean") has had Canadian assistance in its mining for quite some time now. From what I can tell, it is much better for Canadian companies to poison far-away water than Canadian water. Makes sense!

tracks.title: Artifact
tracks.description: Interesting multi-layered blend of percussion rhythms and acoustic guitar, which foreshadows the choir.

tracks.title: As I Figure
tracks.instruments: Kit, Acoustic Guitar, EP, Tenor Sax, Bass
tracks.description: Sort of Spanish, sort of Tom Waits. This one is hard to classify.

tracks.title: Ascending the Vale
tracks.instruments: Harp, Choir, Flute Percussion, Anyafil Horn
tracks.description: We've all been there... wandering through an impenetrable forest, half dead with 2 arrows sticking out of your leg. And yet we continue - because it is probably good for the narrative. Then hope! Oh thank the old gods and the new!! An unmapped settlement of woodland inhabitants takes you in and brings you back from the brink of certain death. You don't even care that it is a scurry of giant squirrels that came to the rescue, or that the healing soup they give you is largely acorn-based, and vomit-inducing. Pastoral and beautiful. The download comes with a loop for if you never want the feeling to end.

tracks.title: Ashton Manor
tracks.instruments: Flute, Clarinet. Violins, Violas, Cellos, Basses, Harp
tracks.description: Flute and clarinet float over a moving and smooth string section.  Change in tone at 26 seconds in.

tracks.title: Asian Drums
tracks.description: A semi-chaotic mix of drums with nice reverb.

tracks.title: At Launch
tracks.instruments: Brass, Marching Snare, Harmon Mute Trumpet, Strings, Orchestral Percussion, Flute
tracks.description: An epic orchestral work featuring heavy brass and strings.  This piece takes the listener on a spirited journey through military might and hopeful adventure.

tracks.title: At Rest
tracks.description: A recurring voice melody cascades over piano chords that sway in the breeze. Strings and horns then play the melody as the piano is slightly more forceful before settling again. It is suggestive of sadness, but with a sense of closure and peace.

tracks.title: At The Shore
tracks.description: A mixture of African vocal chants and Caribbean-styled percussion and bass guitar makes you long for your hammock. The piece is relaxing and gets you in the mood for ?Island Time? - where the troubles of the world melt away in the ocean breeze.

tracks.title: Atlantean Twilight
tracks.description: Time ticks away in a far away place in this little new-age piece.

tracks.title: Atonal in C-ish
tracks.description: Atonal, sure... but almost in the key of C... or C-sharp. No traditional harmonics, fast paced - but measured. The fourth of a series.

tracks.title: Attack of the Mole Men
tracks.instruments: Orchestral featuring French horns, chimes, and tremolo strings
tracks.description: Written as an introduction to a play, this has the feel of a 1950's monster movie.

tracks.title: Aunt Tagonist
tracks.description: Tuba and trumpets with a sting at the end. 2 short versions included, one with trumpets and one without.

tracks.title: Aurea Carmina
tracks.description: Mid-tempo groovy hustle. Perfect for the roller-rink.

tracks.title: Autumn Day
tracks.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Kit, Strings, Piano, Choir
tracks.description: A reflective piece with piano, guitar, simplified percussion, and subtle strings, this music is calm and comforting, like a good book and a hot cup of tea. The chord progressions are interesting and repeat often, which gives the piece a memorable quality.

tracks.title: Avant Jazz
tracks.description: Filtered vibe and horns play against a relentless bass and percussion section.

tracks.title: Ave Marimba
tracks.description: This music is sort of ethnic-nonethnic. It is the sort of thing you can use for your travel video to Cairo, but would also work for your travel video to Columbus, Ohio. Columbus, Ohio - Where blank canvasses become full lives! Visit Columbus on your next getaway! Coffee shops, restaurants, and many seasonal festivals provide a rich backdrop to help make your life seem slightly less desperate. Columbus, Ohio: We have a river!

tracks.title: Avec Soin
tracks.description: Super easy-going slow piano piece. Ends quiet and rich.

tracks.title: Awaiting Return
tracks.description: Piano derivative of Holst's "Thaxted".

tracks.title: Awesome Call
tracks.description: Light and bouncy.

tracks.title: Awkward Meeting
tracks.feel: Dark, Eerie, Intense, Mysterious, Mystical, Suspenseful, Unnerving
tracks.description: Simple piano theme drives this, but it sometimes buried under unnerving textures. 7/4 time, rubato.

tracks.title: B-Roll
tracks.description: Good drums, bass, and very good guitar technique.

tracks.title: B-Roll
tracks.description: Good drums, bass, and very good guitar technique.

tracks.title: Baba Yaga
tracks.description: A little smooth, a little edgy, this has some wicked percussion in it. I forget how many drums there are in this - but it is quite a lot. Doesn't overpower, though. This one could also be considered 140 beats per minute, depending on how you count. It is right in that grey area. And no, I don't know what the words mean... I'm not even certain of the language, or if it is a language. The uncompressed download comes with an extra No Vocals Mix.

tracks.title: Babylon
tracks.description: Smooth chorused delay-drenched bass with lots of cool delayed drumming, and a smattering of high register instruments for interest. Cool, yet intense... or concerning.

tracks.title: Back on Track
tracks.description: A percussion-loaded piece with a cut out in the middle for dialog (or whatever you like).

tracks.title: Backbay Lounge
tracks.description: This is cool. You can walk into a dinner party, grab a glass of prosecco, kiss the host, then casually defuse a large bomb one second before the timer runs out. That level of cool. Maybe you're not that cool, but if you adopt this as your personal theme tune, people will THINK you're that cool.

tracks.title: Backed Vibes
tracks.description: Cool background jazz sound with additional mechanical clicks and beeping.

tracks.title: Backed Vibes (clean)
tracks.description: Cool background jazz sound.

tracks.title: Bad Ideas (clean)
tracks.description: Clean, unaltered pure recording of this piece (see also distressed version).

tracks.title: Bad Ideas (distressed)
tracks.description: Distressed (1930's era vinyl) version.

tracks.title: Balloon Game
tracks.description: When will it end!!?? When will it all end!!?? Honestly... probably never. This piece just keeps modulating. Up a half step every time. Didn't go long enough? Just loop it! It is your own sanity you're toying with.

tracks.title: Balzan Groove
tracks.description: Starts out traditional, moves to all-electronic, then a combination of the two.

tracks.title: Bama Country
tracks.instruments: Harmonica, Violin, Guitar, Bass, Kit, Accordion
tracks.description: Deep South-type country music.

tracks.title: Barroom Ballet
tracks.description: Simple I-V-V-I staccato piano duet.

tracks.title: Basement Floor
tracks.instruments: Synth Keys, Synth Bass, Synth Percussion, Choir
tracks.description: A heavy synth slap bass and processed percussion drive this suspenseful piece. The consistent groove is complemented by a chorus for several more dramatic moments. Heavy Phasing, delay and reverb.

tracks.title: Basic Implosion
tracks.description: Upbeat, bright, and super catchy! Just try not to rap to this piece! TRY IT! You can't, can you! I mean... I can, but I've been training to not rap my entire life. It started with me not-rapping in my childhood in the upper midwest. My lack-of-rapping hit a new high while on a high school band trip to Disneyworld, and was again bolstered in a crazy non-rap filled Spring Break in Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario. There's just something about not-rapping and industrial forestry...

tracks.title: Bass Soli
tracks.description: Solo electric bass with added chorus effect. Nice, round and (of course) low.

tracks.title: Bass Vibes
tracks.description: This piece gets a little atonal in parts.

tracks.title: Bass Walker
tracks.description: Just your average work-a-day upright walking bass line. Add reverb to taste. Noir!

tracks.title: Bassa Island Game Loop
tracks.description: Small section of a piece - loopable for all you looped music needs.

tracks.title: Bathed in the Light
tracks.description: Super light with some sweet cutting sounds. Round, full, and slow.

tracks.title: Batty McFaddin
tracks.description: Gimme a C; a bouncy C! Fun, quirky, off key off colour piece with a few different feels in the middle.

tracks.title: Batty McFaddin - Slower
tracks.description: Gimme a C; a bouncy C! Fun, quirky, off key off colour piece with a few different feels in the middle.  Also available in a faster version.

tracks.title: Beach Bum
tracks.description: Typical surf-type music.

tracks.title: Beach Party
tracks.instruments: Steel Drums, Guitar, Bass, Kit, Organ
tracks.description: Laid back day on an island beach.This piece of music is

tracks.title: Beachfront Celebration
tracks.instruments: Bass, Percussion, Brass, Steel Drums, Piano
tracks.description: If you don't get it from the title, I can't help you. The bass player is pretty awesome. Sort of island-y... in a hyper-real way.

tracks.title: Beauty Flow
tracks.description: Isn't it amazing how compelling an old synthesizer can be when it is being run by an arpeggiator? There are so many subtle patterns that present. Before arpeggiators, we had to find patterns in our music by using corkboards, newspaper clippings, pushpins, coloured yarn, and 8x10 black and white glossy photos.  The percussion does change during this piece, but it won't get in the way of your energetic interview.

tracks.title: Bent and Broken
tracks.description: More soundscape than music. Ideal for all of your zombie, horror, paranormal needs.

tracks.title: Bet You Can
tracks.description: Making a musical mockery using the melody from schoolyard taunts. This pieces rawks out. Major props to the drummer. This is the slower of a set of 2 pieces with the same content.

tracks.title: Bet You Can ver 2
tracks.description: Making a musical mockery using the melody from schoolyard taunts. This pieces rawks out. Nigh inhuman drumming in this. This is the faster of a set of 2 pieces with the same content.

tracks.title: Bicycle
tracks.description: Solo bass. No, it doesn't sound like that song. There are only so many ways make a looped bassline sound. This is one of them. Ends in a super build of chords.

tracks.title: Big Drumming
tracks.description: 4 players. 4 big drums. This is more of an ingredient than a stand-alone piece of music. Serving suggestions: 	Add ambiance to your RPG. 	Spice up your next didgeridoo performance. 	Use as background beats for holiday caroling. 	Entertain with on-hold music for your telecommunications business.

tracks.title: Big Mojo
tracks.feel: Action, Dark, Driving, Epic, Grooving, Intense, Mystical
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Koto, Strings, Flute, Misc Orchestral, Electronic
tracks.description: Big grooving percussion loop with a massive bass kick that will rattle teeth. It starts out with high and low shelves, and kicks in at around 30 seconds. Big ending.

tracks.title: Big Rock
tracks.description: Big fat power chord chunking rock.

tracks.title: Birch Run
tracks.description: Native American drumming, sometimes with rattles. The 2 main drummers are funkier than most Native American pieces.

tracks.title: Bit Quest
tracks.description: Wonderful 8-Bit ditty for an exploring action adventure platformer. My favorite part is at 16 seconds in... The rest of the piece was written around that theme. Check it out, yo! Careful of the spiked kittens on level 7... not cuddly.

tracks.title: Bit Shift
tracks.description: This is about as exciting/happy as simple 8-bit exciting/happy music gets. It's Swingin'! It's Singin'! It's using a whole lotta apostrophes! Sometime's incorrectly! Anyhoo, take a listen to this one. Ye shan't be dis'appointed! Bleep, bloop... bloop, bleep.

tracks.title: Bittersweet
tracks.description: Ok, I might be crying a little bit. But it is understandable... I went to a party store, and I saw all the colorful balloons with happy sayings on them like "Get Well" and "Feel Better" and "A Hug for You"... I just started thinking how the helium will all be gone one day. Just gone... we won't get it back, and it took millions of years of radioactive decay to get the helium we have now... and... *sniff* we just don't have millions more years to wait for more. They're wasting helium in balloons... how can I possibly "Feel Better"!?

tracks.title: Black Bird
tracks.description: Native American drumming with clapping to the feeling of bird wings.

tracks.title: Black Vortex
tracks.feel: Action, Aggressive, Dark, Driving, Epic, Intense, Suspenseful
tracks.instruments: Cimbasso, Tuba, Trombones, French Horns, Trumpets, Basses, Cellos, Violas, Violins, Clarinet, Flute, Synths
tracks.description: Orchestral hybrid piece in 7/8 time. This one starts slow and bold, and ramps into fast and furious with an unrelenting melody.

tracks.title: Bleeping Demo
tracks.description: This piece of music contains pleasing audio information.

tracks.title: Blip Stream
tracks.description: You love this, and you know it! It is a little bit simple and a lot bit complicated. Inspired by the days of the video games and early computer music.

tracks.title: Blipotron
tracks.description: An electronica piece with lots of beeps intermittently throughout.  Starts slowly, intensifies after 46 seconds. Strong bass beats in the background after 46 seconds.

tracks.title: Blippy Trance
tracks.description: Oh that's nice. Like a salve. But the salve might have bits of pumice in it. Don't rub too hard.

tracks.title: Blobby Samba
tracks.description: Super odd fast-and-loose samba-like concoction with wibbly wobbly bits for extra added fun times.

tracks.title: BlockMan
tracks.description: An eerie piece featuring synths.  Great for ambiance.  Starts light, gets progressively eerier and more mysterious.  Climaxes at the end, finishes with a single beat.

tracks.title: Blown Away
tracks.description: If I had to make up a genre for this, it might be punk-electronic. It is certainly high energy and loud and fast.

tracks.title: Blown Away - No Percussion
tracks.description: This is the same as Blown Away, but without any of the drums.

tracks.title: Blue Feather
tracks.feel: Calming, Dark, Eerie, Mysterious, Relaxed, Somber, Unnerving
tracks.description: Somber Solo Piano, with repetitive  descending arpeggio motive.  Contains uplifting moments, but generally sparse and mysterious.

tracks.title: Blue Paint
tracks.description: Calm piano solo centered around a repeating Ab motive.  20 seconds before end the motive expands slightly with an added harmony.

tracks.title: Blue Scorpion
tracks.instruments: Drums, Kalimba, Dulcimer, Synths, Kit, Guitar
tracks.description: An odd mix of African pseudo-polyrhythm and modern overdriven synths. Major feel changes at both 30 seconds and 2 minutes in.

tracks.title: Blue Sizzle
tracks.description: Synth Pad with several swells.

tracks.title: Blue Ska
tracks.instruments: Drums, Bass, Guitar, Organ, Trumpet, Trombone, Tenor Sax
tracks.description: Run of the mill ska!? No such thing! Well, this is as close to that reality as you can get. It is high energy, dance-inducing, happy fun times for everyone who was born after... like... the Industrial Revolution... So, there may be some trees and fungi that don't find this fun; but, I can't really care about their concepts of fun too much. I assume they don't like winters, but they just all sort of stand around all the time.

tracks.title: Boogie Party
tracks.description: Just your everyday 12 bar blues jam. This one is exhausting to play. No MIDI keyboards were injured during the recording of this piece; darn close, though. This piece was written for a Patreon sponsor's project.

tracks.title: Bossa Antigua
tracks.description: Oh hello. I didn't see you there. Welcome to my pad. My favorite parts are the view of the beach, and this very groovy orange shag-carpeting on the walls. I still haven't been able to teach my Roombas to get up by the ceiling, though.

tracks.title: BossaBossa
tracks.description: What makes a Bossa Nova a Bossa Nova? Whatever it is, this has it double! Or maybe it is just compensating for its relatively simple chord progression. Enjoy your Bossa! Probably. Probably a Bossa Nova.

tracks.title: Brain Dance
tracks.description:
Immerse yourself in the pulsating beats of "Brain Dance," a sonic experience that plunges you deep into the heart of the Sixth World. Conjured amidst the neon glow and astral currents of a dystopian Seattle, this track is the essence of a Decker's paradise.

Synthwave textures weave an intricate matrix around you, leaving you entangled in its cybernetic allure. Deck in, chummer, and let the futuristic soundscape rewrite your reality. Wait... what universe is this set in?

tracks.title: Brandenburg Concerto No. 4 in G, Movement I (Allegro), BWV 1049
tracks.instruments: Orchestral - Flute, Violin, Viola, Cello, Harpsichord
tracks.description: Bach. Violin, 2 Flutes (standard C Flute in this case), a mess of strings, and harpsichord. The primary violin is obviously sampled in a few of the faster passages, but the sweet tone shines through nicely on the slower notes. This is my first attempt at a Brandenburg... I suspect I'll revisit this one after I get a few more recorded. Still, it is probably the best free and digital recording available.

tracks.title: Breakdown
tracks.description: A rock standard drum kit kicks out a quick and steady beat. The simplicity of the music calls for simple content that is driving and powerful without being overbearing.

tracks.title: Breaktime
tracks.description: Slower, solo piano version of the "Look Busy" piece (found elsewhere on this site).

tracks.title: Bright Wish
tracks.description: A quick, bright piano piece with no pedaling.

tracks.title: Brightly Fancy
tracks.description: A lively little 2-step with interesting chords.

tracks.title: Brittle Rille
tracks.description: Quirky rhythms. Raw production.

tracks.title: Broken Reality
tracks.description: Intense and somewhat aggressive hard percussion-based track. The strong percussion borders on tribal rhythm with tonal accents.

tracks.title: Bumba Crossing
tracks.description: Sparse and beautiful, this piece has a major change in tone at 2:27, moving to a more energetic feel without destroying what came before. Voluminous choirs support the piece at various moments. They also let the drums stand on their own.

tracks.title: Bumbly March
tracks.instruments: Tuba, Trombones, Pizzicato Violas, Snare, Bass Drum
tracks.description: Lumbering brassy march.

tracks.title: Bummin on Tremelo
tracks.description: Dick Clarks Swingin New Years Eve Bash: Bondi Beach Edition! Forget your parkas! Put on your swim trunks, grab a Fosters, and canoodle with your favorite girl down on the sand!

tracks.title: Bump in the Night
tracks.description: Haunting noises and a tribal drum permeate this eclectic soundscape, and just before the first minute is up demonic breathy noises give way to a chilling silence before the return of the pounding drum. Caution: Very bass heavy.

tracks.title: Burn The World Waltz
tracks.description: Featuring the genuine Nordic Metal talents of Alexander Nakarada. This is a thing the Viennese would totally dance to... if they were MUCH more angry than average Wiener. I'm looking at you, Gunther!

tracks.title: Burnt Spirit
tracks.description: I lost a couple of the synths I used to create this piece between when I wrote it and when I'm releasing it. So, no - I can not do a remix of this piece. If you need less action or less unnerving, seek the answers elsewhere - for this piece has nothing for ye!!

tracks.title: Bushwick Tarantella
tracks.description: An Italian piece that was made nowhere near Italy. Fast, bright and fun!

tracks.title: Bushwick Tarantella Loop
tracks.description: An Italian piece that was made nowhere near Italy. Fast, bright and fun! A longer non-looping version is available.

tracks.title: C-Funk
tracks.instruments: Bass, Kit, Guitar, Bari Sax, Tenor Sax, Trumpet, Percussion
tracks.description: More funk than disco, but more disco than rock. Bongos and guitar reminiscent of a certain genre of film from the 70's.

tracks.title: Call to Adventure
tracks.instruments: Bass, Cello, Viola, Violin, Tuba, Trombone, Horn, Trumpet, Bassoon, Clarinet, Oboe, Flute, Percussion, Xylophone, Marimba, Celesta
tracks.description: A giant orchestral work with everything you could want from a piece with this title.

tracks.title: Calmant
tracks.description: Slow moving, semi-arpeggio theme.

tracks.title: Cambodian Odyssey
tracks.description: Written on spec for a Cambodian documentary. The double-reed horn in the piece is actually a highly processed oboe changed to give an edge.

tracks.title: Canon In D For 8 Bit Synths
tracks.description: Super-Mario world level 2-18, the wedding cake world.

tracks.title: Canon in D for Autoharp
tracks.description: The autoharp is that instrument that has a pile of parallel strings that you strum while pushing buttons to make different chords. I remember these from 5th-grade music class along with flute-o-phones and recorders. What I didn't know back then, is that you can pick individual strings too! You don't have to just strum! This piece is 100% picking. A manual autoharp. Hey Mrs. Withersby, stick that in your flute-o-phone and pluck it!

tracks.title: Canon in D for Two Harps
tracks.description: Harpists, by nature, are solitary people who love horses. Getting harpists to play fast together and contour a melodic line is neigh-on impossible. So we have to give all the notes to one person so it doesn't sound like harp hell. But now you need to rest, because plucking like that is insane, so the other person gets the next tough part.  You also need to make sure that each part makes sense so you can practice it and not feel like you're throwing your soul down a well.  I believe this is the best arrangement of this piece for 2 harps; A thing which should never have been tried. The arrangement itself is in the Public Domain, and sheet music is available.

tracks.title: Canon in D for Two Renaissance Harps
tracks.description: You know Canon in D. You know what an old harp sound like... If you're into that combo - here you go! Wedding processional at a Ren Faire? Check! Background music for a period piece where the period isn't all that important? Check! Timelapse of growing mushrooms? Check!

tracks.title: Canon In D Interstellar Mix
tracks.description: This version of canon in D is so over-the-top, it has gone into orbit! Hah! Bit glitch reggae trap beat. You can tune out the instrumentals and just focus on the trap beat. It's a completely separate entity moving along with the melody like a rowboat following in the wake of a tanker. Or not. I'm not your keeper.

tracks.title: Canon in D Major
tracks.description: Pachelbel's Canon in D Major. Bass continuo with three violins. Harp duet doubling the parts.

tracks.title: Cantina Blues
tracks.description: Interesting mix of styles.

tracks.title: Captain Scurvy
tracks.description: Ahoy thar, and welcome aboard the quirkiest ship in these waters, "The Breakin' Wind"! I be Captain Scurvy. Adventure lies in all directions. I'll leave you now. I'm already late to get me horn piped!

tracks.title: Carefree
tracks.description: Nothing says "It'll be okay" quite like a ukulele.

tracks.title: Carnivale Intrigue
tracks.description: Is it a samba? Probably. It also depends on how broadly you define a samba. Percussion comes in heavy later in the piece with a pile of street drummers for a thicker feel. I'm having a hard time describing the exact groove of this piece. "Slightly whiter than average samba"?

tracks.title: Carpe Diem
tracks.instruments: Clarinet, Ukulele, Flute, Guitar, Xylophone, Percussion, Bass
tracks.description: Yeah Boyzzz! BGM Music in the HOUSE!!!! In this case, "BGM Music" means "Background Music... Music". You want royalty-free!? You got it! You want ukulele mastery!? You got that, too! You want a piece that's a GNDN piece!? DONE! It's like a whole new genre of undistinguished music! It is sort of bouncy, and cheery. So... somewhat distinguished. It is really hard to hype this piece, but it is wicked-useful!

tracks.title: Cartoon Battle
tracks.description: Mongolean sort of battle music. Quite over-the-top.

tracks.title: Casa Bossa Nova
tracks.instruments: Piano, Flute, Bass, Percussion, Organ, Guitar, Mellotron
tracks.description: Okay, the tuning on the bass is a bit off here and there, but the heart is in the right place.Throw a filter on this and use it an your waiting area jam. Or on-hold music. Or pre-show music for your militia function. I'm sure the calming aspects would be very welcome in all the situations! Oh, you can also use this in your dance routines. Because bossa novas rock! ... or they Bossa... not sure.

tracks.title: Cattails
tracks.description: An acoustic guitar and a banjo create a drifting lull as an accordion and erhu play a languid melody. The accordion is slightly forceful, while the tremolo of the erhu is uncertain, creating an intertwined dialogue of two vastly different characters. The piece is calm and pensive, with subtle notes of East Asian and Country Western influences.

tracks.title: Celebration
tracks.description: The good news is, you can take as long as you want to answer the final million dollar question! The bad news is that you have to listen to the synth horns until you're done.

tracks.title: Cello Suite #1 in G - Prelude
tracks.description: Bach's famous cello suite as played on a dulcimer. BWV 1007

tracks.title: Celtic Impulse
tracks.instruments: Hammer Dulcimer, Harp, Bouzouki, Tin Whistle
tracks.description: Simple, easy-to-play folk-influenced tune in the D Dorian mode (related to D Minor).

tracks.title: Cephalopod
tracks.description: Semi-industrial electronic with live percussion bits.

tracks.title: Chanter
tracks.description: Interesting hybrid of at least 3 traditions. For being plodding - it keeps up the intensity to a surprising degree.

tracks.title: Chase
tracks.description: Several mode changes made for an action-like chase scene.

tracks.title: Chase Pulse
tracks.description: Measured pace in low registers that just doesn't stop.

tracks.title: Chase Pulse Faster
tracks.description: Same theme as "Chase Pulse" but with added percussion and a quicker pace.

tracks.title: Chee Zee Beach
tracks.description: Light and breezy loopable piece.

tracks.title: Chee Zee Cave
tracks.description: Loping dissonant loopable atmospheric.

tracks.title: Chee Zee Caves V2
tracks.description: Loping dissonant loopable atmospheric. Same as Chee Vee Caves, but without the brass.

tracks.title: Chee Zee Jungle
tracks.description: Where is this jungle? I have no idea. Videogameland, I suspect.

tracks.title: Chee Zee Lab
tracks.description: Semi-industrial loopable driving piece.

tracks.title: Cheery Monday
tracks.description: Clappy 50's inspired simple fun track.

tracks.title: Cherry Blossom
tracks.description: A non-offensive, non-obtrusive piece to go under anything that feels a little flat.

tracks.title: Children's Theme
tracks.description: Progressively darker and darker version of "This Old Man".

tracks.title: Chill
tracks.description: Bass feature piece with some rich laid-back synth, and a thin-sounding drum machine.

tracks.title: Chill Wave
tracks.description: I was looking for a subject to analogize the depth of my knowledge for the Chill Wave genre of music. Wikipedia was there for me with entire things that I didn't even know were things; Randle Cotgrave! Yeon Namgeon!  Digital Mammographic Imaging! Rebelj, Serbia! In brief... I know nothing about Chill Wave. Hope you enjoy the fruits of ignorance!

tracks.title: Chillin Hard
tracks.description: Cross Hip-hop with Shoegaze and what do you get? That was not a joke. That was the description of this piece. If you have a show that opens with a shoegaze band, and then headlines a hip-hop group you could use this as the clever bridge between them! Also, you should immediately fire the concert manager. That was a terrible idea.

tracks.title: Chipper
tracks.description: Simple simple simple distortion guitar rock; no solos, no highlights; make up your own words if you're so inclined.

tracks.title: Chipper Doodle
tracks.description: Happy little tune with asynchronous edits, and unexpected modulations.

tracks.title: Chipper Doodle v2
tracks.description: Happy little tune with asynchronous edits, and unexpected modulations.

tracks.title: Christmas Rap
tracks.description: I was commissioned to do some music for the play "Twas The Night Before Christmas" by Ken Ludwig. The mp3 download here is the main holiday-themed rap from near the end of the play. The uncompressed download comes with that as well as the Girl/Mouse rap from earlier in the play - which you can hear on Soundcloud as "La Souris". The full download also has the exciting fanfare intros to the holiday rap.

tracks.title: Chromatic Fantasia (Bach BWV 930)
tracks.description: Bach. WARNING! This is a very baroque organ piece. It sounds very old. Not something you listen to unless you're into that kind of thing.

tracks.title: Chromatic Fuge (Bach BWV 930)
tracks.description: Bach. Among the most complex fugues ever written.

tracks.title: Chucky the Construction Worker
tracks.description: Modern children's TV theme. Written for a stage performance. Peppy and mildly electronic.

tracks.title: Cipher
tracks.description: I've been told this is R&B, but could be a few other things. It is certainly pretty neat. Warning: Very sticky hook.

tracks.title: Circus of Freaks
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Trumpets, Xylophone, Tubas, Trombones, Flutes, Clarinets
tracks.description: What do you do with a drunken ogre?

tracks.title: Circus Tent
tracks.description: With a bouncing bass and frantic trumpet blasts, the cymbals crash and instantly take you inside the circus tent, where a tense high-wire act competes with the rotund ringmaster. The music is jovial and intense, with a flair of ridiculousness.

tracks.title: Circus Waltz
tracks.description: General-purpose upbeat piece which can be used in general dialog.

tracks.title: Clash Defiant
tracks.instruments: Basses, Cellos, War Horn, Brass, Percussion, Choir
tracks.description: You want battle music? You can't HANDLE the battle music! Meh. You probably can. As battle music goes, this is pretty tame - no blaring trumpets or hyperactive xylophones... Why? Dialog! You can actually talk over this battle music! Feel free to punctuate with your own stabs after you cut around your dialog. Or don't. You can use this as a loop on your Twitch stream for anything... battle-y. That rough spiccato bass line is off the hook! (Do people still say "off the hook"? I might be a few years late on that.)  .

tracks.title: Classic Horror 1
tracks.description: Solo piano, which is not in tune (traditionally speaking). 4/4 time with some asymmetries.

tracks.title: Classic Horror 2
tracks.description: 5/8 time gives this piano solo a really unsettling feel. It uses more of the range of the piano, and can be chopped up to suit scenes well.

tracks.title: Classic Horror 3
tracks.description: Alternate tuning is very apparent here, Deep voicing lends a very ominous quality. Sounds more like the mind of someone who is breaking.

tracks.title: Clean Soul
tracks.description: Very clean soft piece with a lot of space in it.

tracks.title: Clear Air
tracks.description: Very easy-going piece for acoustic steel string guitar and classical guitar. Second A section includes deep and soft piano.

tracks.title: Clear Waters
tracks.description: Simple and light of weight solo.

tracks.title: Clenched Teeth
tracks.description: Timpanis and strings battle with a snare drum and horns throughout this epic piece, slowly building and rising to chaos. The music is high-action and only includes a few short dramatic interludes.

tracks.title: Cloud Dancer
tracks.description:
Upbeat EDM track with a fast tempo and modern vibe. It is joyful, optimistic, and playful. Good for dynamic, high-energy sequences. A straightforward, mood-lifting piece that adds excitement and movement.


Synthwave textures weave an intricate matrix around you, leaving you entangled in its cybernetic allure. Deck in, chummer, and let the futuristic soundscape rewrite your reality. Wait... what universe is this set in?

tracks.title: Club Diver
tracks.feel: Aggressive, Dark, Driving, Grooving, Intense, Unnerving
tracks.description: Almost like euro club meets industrial vampires. I don't think I've ever done anything similar to this from the percussion side... or with those diving chord things.

tracks.title: Club Seamus
tracks.description: Every once in a generation, a song title comes along that perfectly melds with the music. This is such a piece.  It could only be called "Club Seamus". "Club Seamus" could only sound like this.

tracks.title: Cognitive Dissonance
tracks.description: Main theme used in two different treatments. Specifically designed to turn your brain around... one sort of gets lost in the fog in the middle, and ends up pointing the wrong way by the end. Starts with a very long slow fade.

tracks.title: Cold Funk
tracks.description: A calming rock piece.  Repeated guitar chords as well as bass throughout.  Very light use of bells.  Great for looping if needed.

tracks.title: Cold Sober
tracks.instruments: Bass, Drums, Guitar, Electric Piano, Uilleann Pipes
tracks.description: You know what, I honestly don't know what I was thinking here. This is one of those "throw things at the wall and see if it works" kinds of pieces. It would have been completely uninteresting were it not for the Uilleann Pipes. Not a lot of music out there for bagpipes and electric piano. Consider the void filled!

tracks.title: Colorless Aura
tracks.description: Extraordinarily depressing piano solo. Please treat with caution... or meds.

tracks.title: Colossus
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Brass, English Horn, Alto Flute, Bass Clarinet, Bassoons
tracks.description: Nice mid-level orchestral action piece. Culmination at 3:43.

tracks.title: Come Play with Me
tracks.instruments: Voice, Flute, Alto Flute, Clarinet, Basses, Cellos, Glockenspiel
tracks.description: Creepy children's song.

tracks.title: Comedic Juggernaut
tracks.instruments: Tympani, Brass, Saxes, Clarinet, Kit, String section
tracks.description: New Orleans style meets Spike Jones... sort of.

tracks.title: Comfortable Mystery
tracks.description: Solo vintage electric piano. Not quite supernatural... more like surreal. Slow with descending arpeggios.

tracks.title: Comfortable Mystery 2
tracks.description: Gentle electric piano chords and descending arpeggi are featured in this calming piece.

tracks.title: Comfortable Mystery 3
tracks.description: Gentle Electric Piano with a descending arpeggiated motive. The ending gradually slows.

tracks.title: Comfortable Mystery 4
tracks.description: Gentle Electric Piano featuring light chords and a descending arpeggiated motive.

tracks.title: Comic Hero
tracks.description: Tuba carries the character of the piece.

tracks.title: Comic Plodding
tracks.description: Impromptu.

tracks.title: Comin Round the Mountain
tracks.description: Electro-acoustic rendering of the famous American folk song.

tracks.title: Concentration
tracks.description: Imagine yourself floating in a beautiful sky, the aggressive badgers of the land do not bother you here at all. Todd from HR doesn't try to make small talk with you in this place, nor does he try to invite you to his kid's wrestling tournament that is being held at a school 90 minutes away. The coyote-lizards of your night terrors do not roam here, and you can clearly read the expiration dates on all your packages. Even the hand soap. Why does the hand soap have an expiration date? It matters not.

tracks.title: Confused State
tracks.instruments: Percussion, marimba, kalimba, bassoon, clarinet, oboe,
tracks.description: Interesting mallet-only section in the middle that sort of has a dreamy-yet earthy feel to it.

tracks.title: Consequence
tracks.description: Moderately paced driving composition featuring xylophone and cowbell. No, I'm not kidding.

tracks.title: Consort for Brass
tracks.description: A stately brass choir set in a cathedral.

tracks.title: Constance
tracks.feel: Action, Dark, Epic, Intense, Mysterious, Suspenseful
tracks.description: A low-level intensity burn to underscore a tense situation of some sort. Actually, this will make any scene tense - like it or not.

tracks.title: Constancy Part One
tracks.instruments: Strings, Chimes, Glock, Bassoon, Bass Clarinet
tracks.description: A rapid piece full of alternating strings and bassoons, with long and drastic bass notes. The heavy funereal chimes and foreboding minor key evoke a scene of a frantic chase through the woods or a race against time.

tracks.title: Constancy Part Three
tracks.description: Beautiful sweeping strings run counter to an energetic wind section with light accents from the glock's piercing bell tones.

tracks.title: Constancy Part Two
tracks.instruments: Strings, Chimes, Tympani, Flute, Bass Clarinet, Bassoon, Oboe
tracks.description: Full of rhythmic strings and woodwinds in the lower registers, the high pitched violin that edges in and out of tune is unnerving and eerie. The pounding bass drums and church bells ring throughout, a symbol of impending doom. This music draws the line between being beautiful and frighteningly dystopian.

tracks.title: Continue Life
tracks.description: Solo new-age piano.

tracks.title: Controlled Chaos
tracks.feel: Dark, Eerie, Intense, Mysterious, Suspenseful, Unnerving
tracks.description: Weird synth drone with a soundtrack-style percussion backing driver.

tracks.title: Controlled Chaos - no percussion
tracks.description: Dark background drone made with the new SkannerXT synth. It is a new kind of synthesis that I'm just getting into. Kinda freaky.

tracks.title: Cool Blast
tracks.description: Sort of dance, sort of jazz.

tracks.title: Cool Hard Facts
tracks.description: Tight drums and power guitars... in some trapezoid of death. Synth-y Ending.

tracks.title: Cool Intro
tracks.description: A cool short intro written for a writing podcast. Kit and bass used throughout.  Organ used mainly in the beginning.

tracks.title: Cool Rock
tracks.description: Cool, yet energetic rock. Mostly kit and bass.

tracks.title: Cool Vibes
tracks.description: A simple little slow trio for use in such things that require a slow jazz trio. Modulates at the midpoint.

tracks.title: Corncob
tracks.description: Bouncy country tune featuring fast banjo picking and grooving shuffle on the drumset.

tracks.title: Corruption
tracks.instruments: Basses, Cellos, War Horn, Brass, Percussion, Choir
tracks.description: Formerly titled "Tyranid Battle Loop", this piece was written for down and dirty... and very very long battle scenes for space bug critters. But you can use it for anything you like! Got a video where you stuck a cucumber on a drone to terrorize your cat? Boom! Corruption. Or those really gross films of people removing cysts? ug. don't use this for that. Actually, why are you posting that? Don't do it. Just... ug. can't unsee...

tracks.title: Cortosis
tracks.instruments: Tympani, Basses, Trumpets, Trombones, Tuba, Violins, Percussion, Flute, Oboe, Clarinet, Bass Clarinet, Cellos
tracks.description: Fight sequence in a galaxy far, far away. Several changes of feel throughout.

tracks.title: Cottages
tracks.description: You know the old phrase "as relaxing as a toaster"? They meant any electrical machine, really. I think if a toaster were to make relaxing music this is it.

tracks.title: Court of the Queen
tracks.description: Slow Waltz. English Waltz. Foxtrot. Slow Fox. Regal in its construction, this waltz is meant for the ballroom floor of a grand soiree. The pizzicato strings provide the rhythm in the first half, while strings and horns play the melody. A harp accompanies a celeste in creating transitions between segments of the music. As the music crescendos into the third minute, the frivolity turns more serious, and the piece ends with a few interchangeable chords between the celeste and the horns.

tracks.title: Covert Affair
tracks.description: The scene is set for a surreptitious heist or furtive affair. The fingered acoustic bass sounds woody and dark while playing against the light cymbals and the vibrant electric piano and trumpet. The individual instruments have a slight battle for dominance, but the persistence of the slick styled bass ultimately wins.

tracks.title: Cowboy Sting
tracks.description: Very western-sounding sting. This comes in 75, 83, and  88 beats per minute - along with a very short cut.

tracks.title: Creeping to Ship
tracks.description: Low brass / bassoons with pizz. Mild stings on the end. (written for Darker Projects' Falcon Banner Episode 4)

tracks.title: Cretaceous Dawn
tracks.description: This piece is one of three pieces that was inspired by a trip to a dinosaur-themed roadside attraction that had "dinosaur music". That music was recorded in the early 1990s, and sounds a bit cheesy today, so I tried to update it. This piece is a hybrid of triggered samples and live recordings.

tracks.title: Crinoline Dreams
tracks.instruments: Piano, Violin, Viola, Bass, Cello, Double Bass
tracks.description: You ever get the feeling to just hang out on a skating pond with a beagle?  Make sure you hit play on this track!

tracks.title: Crisis
tracks.description: A very serious and straight dark orchestral piece. Tubular bells, bass trombone, and bass drum add a lot of low-end.

tracks.title: Crossing the Chasm
tracks.instruments: Drums, Basses, Cellos, Violas, Violins, Singer
tracks.description: Adventure, Ho! Last time on "Adventure, Ho!", the mage-orc Gnarlnosh was granted 1d4 wishes from a Deck of Many Things and it totally screwed up the game balance. Why? Because the DM sort of sucks, but he thought "Oh, sure - this could be fun... how could giving a mage-orc a fully provisioned army in the middle of a desert possibly sidetrack the quest for finding a cure for a magical disease that is ruining the kingdom AND the healer elf." Deck of Many Things; BAH! More like Deck of This-Campaign-Jumped-the-Shark.

tracks.title: Crossing the Divide
tracks.instruments: Piano, Trumpet, French Horn, Basses, Cellos
tracks.description: Americana western-sounding piece. It kicks in around 1:14. This was composed for the film "Duel" (2014).

tracks.title: Crowd Hammer
tracks.instruments: Guitar, Percussion, Diddley Bow, Flute, Oboe
tracks.description: Originally written as an establishing shot for a psychological thriller. This has a very earthy/folky feel about it. Little slow, little edgy... I don't know. Take a listen. I mean, I'll keep trying to describe this but, I'm not doing too well here. There's this flute thing... uhh... Slightly creepy movie score? Yet oddly comforting? Sure. Let's go with that.

tracks.title: Cruising for Goblins
tracks.description: Dear Green Valkyrie, Your life force is running out. Green Valkyrie needs food badly. Remember; Don't shoot food. Someone shot the food. Your shots now hurt other players. You just shot the potion. C'mon Green Valkyrie, you got no chill.

tracks.title: Crunk Knight
tracks.description: Medieval meets club beats.

tracks.title: Crusade
tracks.description: Written as travelling music for a video game... this is probably a bit too active for that. There is a beautiful choral section in the trombones at 2:18. Good anvils.

tracks.title: Crusade - Heavy Industry
tracks.instruments: Basses, Cellos, Anvils, French Horns, Euphoniums, Trombones, Tubas, Trumpets, Percussion
tracks.description: Do you have recurring dreams of being an industrial roomba working in an ore processing facility? Do you make fantasy paintings and need some music for timelapses? Do you go jog-hopping in low-gravity post-apocalyptic environments? Do you have opinions about eggs? Are you a monster who is in charge of other monsters? Did you work on a top-hat/sombrero assembly line? Are you starting a ferry line on the river Acheron to compete with Charon? Are you drafting epic legislation? Do you enjoy hitting dumpsters with sticks?

tracks.title: Cryptic Sorrow
tracks.description: Sad solo piano with a "reality" feel. Uneven meters.

tracks.title: Crypto
tracks.description: Very moody little piece with some melodic interest. Tension could be high grade or low grade depending on your context. Waiting for a drug deal to go through in Belize? This'll work. Concerned about the health of your hyacinth macaw while waiting at the vet office? This'll work. Waiting for the OSHA all-clear at your box factory? This'll work. It is mainly about waiting for things. Probably not good things.

tracks.title: Cuban Sandwich
tracks.description: A groovy little piece excellent for an evening at your local cabana.

tracks.title: Cupid's Revenge
tracks.description: Celestial themed video game music.

tracks.title: Curse of the Scarab
tracks.instruments: Xylophone, English Horn, Oboe, Bass Clarinet, Flutes, French Horn, Basses, Cellos, Percussion
tracks.description: Five! Five full minutes of battle fighting action bits with a bit of an Egyptian flair! For some reason I associate English horn with desert nomads. There must have been some cultural reference in my youth to that effect. Super crazy awesome brass is super crazy awesome... wait for it... you'll be glad you did! Uncompressed download comes with fully loopable mix.

tracks.title: Cut and Dry
tracks.description: Modern-style production of a dance/world music fusion. Laser sharp super compressed mix.

tracks.title: Cut and Run
tracks.description: Modern club music.

tracks.title: Cut Trance
tracks.description: Semi-trance, semi-techno with a couple of touches of piano. Pretty driving for being so slow. Super super clean mix that'll rattle your walls.

tracks.title: Cyborg Ninja
tracks.description: Your girlfriend has be kidnapped by ninja! Stage 1: Desert. Avoid the flaming balls and shoot cyborg ninja in the eye to win round. Retro-gaming circa 1988. I was seriously considering naming this piece "Flaming Balls" as that would also have been appropriate. Cyborg ninjas are just a little more '1988' to me. Need 10 hours of this? Loop it!

tracks.title: Daily Beetle
tracks.instruments: Ukulele, Guitar, Marimba, Music Box, Toy Piano, Drums
tracks.description: We have ways of making you happy! This is one of them. Super catchy mid-tempo grooving ukulele-driven happy music. Useful for: feel-good stories, sentimental retrospectives, Minecraft montages, shark attacks, coming of age stories, cooking shows, and baby raves.

tracks.title: Dama-May
tracks.description: Simple oddly asynchronous piece where the percussion and melody get along, but in an aloof sort of way.

tracks.title: Dance Monster
tracks.description: A remix of one of my own pieces "120 BPM Monster" by special request. This one is longer, and more sharply mixed.

tracks.title: Dance of Deception
tracks.description: Pipe organ piece. This is apparently a 'Czardas', a traditional Hungarian folk dance. I would like to thank Keith for the info.

tracks.title: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairies
tracks.description: Tchaikovsky's famous dance from the Nutcracker Suite.

tracks.title: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy
tracks.description: Tchaikovsky's piece, amped up a little bit and slightly arranged for more punch and bass.

tracks.title: Dance of the Tuba Plum Fairy
tracks.instruments: Tubas, Trombones, Trumpets, Piano, Bells, Percussion
tracks.description: Mrs. Johnson's 4 grade band presents Tchaikovsky's "Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairies"! Featuring: Jacob on Tuba, Hailey on Euphonium, Kaylee and Caleb on Trombone, Jayden and Joey on Trumpet, Riley on Bass Drum, Abigail on Snare Drum, Zoey on Cymbals, Aubrey on Glockenspiel, Ethan on Sleigh Bells, and Mrs. Johnson on Piano. Arrangement by Kevin MacLeod.

tracks.title: Dances and Dames
tracks.description: Off-center feeling film noir-like piece with a continually changing time signature. "Something is amiss on the streets. My job is to figure that out."

tracks.title: Danger Storm
tracks.description: So this one sounds like what is sounds like. The high quality download has a few bonus mixes. The Tin Mix is excellent for small speakers. The Phased Mix is like... sort of groovy, man. The 90 mix is a bit faster. And the House Mix is super dance party fun times!

tracks.title: Dangerous
tracks.feel: Action, Dark, Driving, Eerie, Epic, Intense, Unnerving
tracks.description: Crescendo and sting at the end.

tracks.title: Danse Macabre
tracks.description: Written by Saint Saens in 1874. This is a quite well known and epic piece of music.

tracks.title: Danse Macabre - Big Hit 1
tracks.description: A 2 note hit from a section change in Danse Macabre. It can be used as a very short ending sting.

tracks.title: Danse Macabre - Big Hit 2
tracks.description: Another 2-note hit from the interior of Danse Macabre.

tracks.title: Danse Macabre - Busy Strings
tracks.description: An interesting section of Danse Macabre from around measure 145. There is a particularly nice viola trill with ornament.

tracks.title: Danse Macabre - Finale
tracks.description: Just the finale from the "Danse Macabre". This is the highest energy portion of the piece in isolation.

tracks.title: Danse Macabre - Light Dance
tracks.description: A small section of Danse Macabre that features the basses, cellos, and violas each taking one beat out of the measure with a triplet. Light melody on the top.

tracks.title: Danse Macabre - Low Strings Finale
tracks.description: Just the low strings and brass from the finale of "Danse Macabre".

tracks.title: Danse Morialta
tracks.description: Simple, simple, effective piano piece. This one is hard to pin down emotionally, so I marked it at both somber and uplifting. It is really quite good... though not quite Satie.

tracks.title: Danse of Questionable Tuning
tracks.description: Interesting piano and cello piece.  As title suggests, there is some questionable tuning.  Piece begins with piano, brings in cello around 00:05, both continue until the end of the piece.

tracks.title: Dark Dance
tracks.instruments: Violin, Glock, Strings, Flutes, Piano, Trombones, Tuba
tracks.description: Winds, piano, and brass come in very late. The piece accelerates to the end.

tracks.title: Dark Fog
tracks.description: The title refers to a state of mind more than a physical thing. That sort of feeling you get when there are choices to be made... none of them very good ones.

tracks.title: Dark Hallway (clean)
tracks.description: Clean version of this piece. 2 sections; one choppy, and one smooth. (see also distressed)

tracks.title: Dark Hallway (distressed)
tracks.description: Distressed (1930's era vinyl) version of this piece. 2 sections; one choppy, and one smooth.

tracks.title: Dark Pad
tracks.description: This is a dark and eerie arrhythmic thing with deep lows and cutting highs. Experimental only in the personal sense - I just got GarageBand, and I'm seeing what the (very nice) electronic effects can do.

tracks.title: Dark Standoff
tracks.description: Broad dark sustained chords in the low strings punctuated with slight percussion.

tracks.title: Dark Star
tracks.description: Dark Star is a orchestral fanfare featuring a rising motive led by the brass and strings.  The piece builds gradually and finishes with a full orchestral climax.

tracks.title: Dark Times
tracks.description: Deeply troubling and somber, this piece is heavy on the bass strings, especially in the last minute. The feel is very dark and funereal, and could be used to depict the beginning of the apocalypse.

tracks.title: Dark Walk
tracks.description: Simple motive countered by several striking dissonances.

tracks.title: Darkening Developments
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Synth Bass, Bass section, Oboe, Bassoon, Clarinet, Piccolo
tracks.description: Bass is very VERY strong in this. Please make sure you master on a system capable of reproducing these notes. The end feel is decided different from the rest of the piece. It does an unnerving build to nowhere.

tracks.title: Darkest Child
tracks.description: A childlike celeste plays high notes among a barely audible harp and deep bass. In the second minute the disturbing melody is in a lower register, and strings accentuate the discordant sounds before returning to the high register. The music is excellent for a creepy dream sequence or the exposition of an unknown fantasy world. SMARTSOUND

tracks.title: Darkest Child var A
tracks.description: A notably quicker version of "Darkest Child".

tracks.title: Darkling
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Violins, Violas, Cellos, Basses, Flutes, Clarinets
tracks.description: Pulsing Dooom! Recommended for use in all your various adventure-y side-scrollers with lots of shooting or stabbing, and the occasional jump-scare. Should loop really great!

tracks.title: Darkness is Coming
tracks.description: Quiet yet epic. This piece is an odd mix. Highly processed drum kit.

tracks.title: DarxieLand
tracks.description: A rousingly comedic romp on the dark side of Dixieland music, featuring a wonderfully questionable trumpet player!

tracks.title: Day of Chaos
tracks.instruments: Piano, Percussion, Synths, Strings, Brass, Glock
tracks.description: Abrasive upright piano sets the tone for this start-stop horror suspense piece.

tracks.title: Daybreak
tracks.description: Solo vintage electric piano. Lounge/New Age.

tracks.title: Daytime TV Theme
tracks.description: Slow and deliberate.

tracks.title: DD Groove
tracks.description: Very laid-back piece that may be indicative of a loss, or possibly carelessness.

tracks.title: Dead Drop
tracks.description: Super nice drum fills and guitar work. Deliberate pace... like someone is on a mission.

tracks.title: Deadly Roulette
tracks.instruments: Drums, Bass, SynthBass, Guitar, Vibes, Percussion
tracks.description: Jazzy! Gumshoe-y! Mystery-y! I suck at making adjectives. Who needs adjectives anyway! I'm fine without adjectives. How fine without adjectives, you may ask? I can't say - as that would require some sort of descriptor! And I don't need descriptors in my writings... Maybe one... tiny little... NO! What am I thinking!? I refuse! I've completely had it with adjectives! Hah! Adverbs work perfectly fine! Woohoo! Adverbs! And before I get mail... adjectives killed my family, so I can go off on them all I want.

tracks.title: Death and Axes
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Trumpets, French Horns, Trombones, Tuba, Cimbasso, Clarinets, Flutes, Piccolo, Oboe, Violins, Violas, Cellos, Basses, Chimes
tracks.description: Holy epic action. Just look at the instruments in this! The piece shall now speak for itself.

tracks.title: Death of Kings
tracks.instruments: French Horns, Trombones, Cimbasso, Trumpets, Drum, Chimes
tracks.description: Deep and rich piece of remembrance for brass. The melody is carried by the horn, with some help later by trumpets.

tracks.title: Decay
tracks.description: A very dark piece heavily featuring cymbal and bells.  Frequent Cymbal usage creates unnerving feeling.  3:08 prolonged trombone.  Lasts almost 30 seconds.  This piece is great for an eerie atmosphere.

tracks.title: Decisions
tracks.description: A vocal chorus blends with subtle percussion and panning synth effects that rattles the bones. The choir rises in volume almost imperceptibly before dissolving, leaving a sense of drama and consequence. Perfect for the background music to build suspense and intrigue. Loopable.

tracks.title: Deck the Halls A
tracks.description: Piano solo of the traditional holiday piece. Very smooth with seemingly random phrasing. This isn't really a sing-along type recording.

tracks.title: Deck the Halls B
tracks.instruments: Piano, Clarinet, Guitar, Flute, Kit, Tuba
tracks.description: Repeating, peppy sing-along version of the holiday classic.

tracks.title: Decline
tracks.description: Slow and mildly creepy with a hint of beautiful.

tracks.title: Deep and Dirty
tracks.description: I'm awake, I'm awake! Okay! Holy man! Wow. That is a lot.

tracks.title: Deep Haze
tracks.description: A lighter piece than the descriptors would imply. It is more hollow than dark, more motion-forward than driving. Builds continuously but slowly.

tracks.title: Deep Noise
tracks.description: Could be breathing, could be the wind, it is very dark, and kind of disturbing.

tracks.title: Deep Relaxation
tracks.description: The main melody is a stack of harp, piano, and electric piano. The bass is just a nice mono synth.

tracks.title: Del Rio Bravo
tracks.description: I'm gonna come clean here. I have no idea what this is. Mexican? Maybe? Dance music? Drinking music? I don't even understand what this would do culturally.

tracks.title: Delay Rock
tracks.description: Super simple guitar/bass/drums rock tune.

tracks.title: Deliberate Thought
tracks.description: Calming round electronic music with a nice delay... and a choir.

tracks.title: Delightful D
tracks.description: Welcome to the Holiday Inn, Airport. The presentation will begin shortly.   SUCCESS starts with your ATTITUDE!   If you are not EARNING, make sure you are LEARNING!   AMBITION is the path to success. PERSISTENCE is the vehicle you arrive in.  Success is doing the OPPOSITE of what everyone else is DOING!   Actually... don't take this last one too literally. If everyone else is using the door, don't try walking through a wall (or whatever the opposite of a "door" is). I mean... there is a reason most people do the same things. Usually because they make sense. Oh, sure... it is okay to QUESTION what people are doing, but just doing the opposite... probably not great.   The future of NETWORK MARKETING is UNLIMITED!   Oh... Also a bit of hyperbole here. I mean, it literally cannot exceed the gross output of all the world's economies - and will likely top out far before that due to INEFFICIENCIES and REGULATION.

tracks.title: Dentaneosuchus Hunt
tracks.description: This piece is one of three pieces that was inspired by a trip to a dinosaur-themed roadside attraction that had "dinosaur music". That music was recorded in the early 1990s, and sounds a bit cheesy today, so I tried to update it. This piece is a hybrid of triggered samples and live recordings.

tracks.title: Der Kleber Sting
tracks.description: Your standard "dun dun DUUUUN!" hit.

tracks.title: Derp Nugget
tracks.description: There is nothing in this piece that is even vaguely reminiscent of "La Macarena".  I shouldn't have said that. I should not have said that. Don't go listening for it,  for such a journey will surely end in tragedy.

tracks.title: Desert City
tracks.description: Middle Eastern atmospheric, sort of chill. This piece is easy to loop.

tracks.title: Desert of Lost Souls
tracks.description: Typical activities in the Desert of Lost Souls include, but are not limited to: Camel jumping, Sand dune surfing, Mummy hunting, Beetle breeding, and Comparative analysis of Bayesian and classical approaches for sheep reliability measurement.

tracks.title: Despair and Triumph
tracks.description: Very moody digitally altered piano.

tracks.title: Destiny Day
tracks.description: My work has been seminal in the development of 'structuredly-non-linear symmetrical-music', a highly intellectual, and rather repetitive genre. My newest piece studies, experiences and isomorphically dominates a variety of structured tension-hemiolas. In short, the method must never present the sound-world. I never examine continuities, despite the fact that any gesture or non-linearity can be, and has been interpreted as a rather orchestrally-monophonic set of 'canon-aerophones'. In my most recent work, vibrations, materials and rhythmic oscillations are all used within chaotically-transdisciplinary gestures, allowing the audience to improvise a variety of symbolic idioms. I am very much influenced by the idea of dismissing popular solos, particularly whilst combined with a highly polyrhythmic approach to spaces.

tracks.title: Deuces
tracks.description: 1960s club-style jazz. This pairs well with the White Russian cocktail and a Lucky Strike. Also pretty decent for establishing shots, and anything sci-fi that has a retro party.

tracks.title: Devastation and Revenge
tracks.feel: Eerie, Epic, Intense, Mystical, Somber, Suspenseful
tracks.instruments: Synths, Percussion, Strings, Brass, Guitar, Voice
tracks.description: A low hum sets a dark and mysterious mood, but at 0:49 the orchestral strings, horns, and pounding drums begin, perfect as the background to the hero?s dilemma or impending battle scene. At 2:01 the music reaches a climax and builds into discordant, terrifying suspense. The ending, at 2:35, features a lone guitar and mournful vocals, depicting a great sadness and loss.

tracks.title: Devonshire Waltz Allegretto
tracks.instruments: Piano, Bass, Strings, French Horn, Trumpet, Flutes, Clarinets, Kit
tracks.description: This is more for practicing dance than anything else. There are occasional bits with wind instruments to break it up a bit.   Available in three tempos: 84, 93, and 104.

tracks.title: Devonshire Waltz Andante
tracks.instruments: Piano, Bass, Strings, French Horn, Trumpet, Flutes, Clarinets, Kit
tracks.description: This is more for practicing dance than anything else. There are occasional bits with wind instruments to break it up a bit.   Available in three tempos: 84, 93, and 104.

tracks.title: Devonshire Waltz Moderato
tracks.instruments: Piano, Bass, Strings, French Horn, Trumpet, Flutes, Clarinets, Kit
tracks.description: This is more for practicing dance than anything else. There are occasional bits with wind instruments to break it up a bit.   Available in three tempos: 84, 93, and 104.

tracks.title: Dewdrop Fantasy
tracks.description: The smell of a garden hose, that muted crack when you start up a glowstick, watching the sunrise with a glass of freshly squeezed orange juice... all so calming... This piece of music is like that. Simple, bleeping, and slowly changing. Can you think of something else that is simple, bleeping, and changing? "an old PC speaker?" well, that's simple and bleeping. "EDM?" that's... bleeping and changing. "Hippie fashion?" that's... Hippie fashion? I don't know what that is. Well, it is long hair and paisley bell-bottoms and far too many beads... You just found the outside of the Venn Diagram.

tracks.title: Dhaka
tracks.description: Melodic-based music inspired by the Sarod music of northern India.

tracks.title: Digital Bark
tracks.description: Background horror music. Electronic. Kind of tech-horror sounding... Highly unnerving.

tracks.title: Digital Lemonade
tracks.description: Good good, goodness so good! Deeply satisfying analog synths alongside a jaunty beat. Nuff said.

tracks.title: Digya
tracks.description: Is good. A little more melodic than most.

tracks.title: Dirt Rhodes
tracks.description: A slow blues piece with prominent kit.  Actual Mark I Stage Piano used in this recording.  EP used throughout in the background.

tracks.title: Disco con Tutti
tracks.instruments: Synths, EP, Kit, Trumpets, Trombones, Guitar
tracks.description: Disco with a funky horn section and acid synths. Very bright mix.

tracks.title: Disco Lounge
tracks.description: Umm... this is really hard to describe. Take a listen, you might need it. Easy chill disco. It has an "eye of the tiger"-ish synth line and a super cool vibe part. Drum kit is distressed in parts.

tracks.title: Disco Medusae
tracks.description: Discomedusae is an obsolesced class of jellyfish. I'm guessing there was some biology schism back in the day and some crazy jellyfish specialist wrote some sort of definitive work on the animals and everyone had to change their classification. The jerk. I mean, it was probably JUST FINE the way it was! But NOOooo! You had to come along and screw up my perfectly good taxonomy key - rendering it USELESS! Hey jellyfish specialist - guess what? No one cares that much anyway! We're all just placating you until you die, and then everyone is going back to using the old keys, which we could at least figure out! This is a disco tune.

tracks.title: Disconcerned
tracks.description: Broad minor chords moving slowly in parallel. Reminds me of Holst.

tracks.title: Discovery Hit
tracks.description: Super giant epic 3 note sting.

tracks.title: Dispersion Relation
tracks.instruments: Kit, Bass, Piano, Vibes, Trumpet, Flute
tracks.description: A neat little upbeat jazz piece with a crazy bouncy bass and overactive drummer.

tracks.title: Disquiet
tracks.description: On January 31st, 2015, I recorded this piece. For some reason, I hit the record button and played. This is all of the notes. There are no other takes; No other files from that day. I don't remember what I was doing, but I was apparently dealing with fear and hope and apprehension... at least that is what it sounds like to me today - months later. Every now and again, I'll find these files - they are something of an emotional journal. Hope you enjoy it as much as I do! Download has the original MIDI file!

tracks.title: Dissappointment
