tracks.description: Very slow piece featuring bass clarinet with a couple of backing double basses.

tracks.title: Distant Tension
tracks.description: Background horror music. Symphonic with some digital processing. Some tremolo basses in the beginning are meant to be removed and integrated on their own.

tracks.title: District Four
tracks.description: Deep grooving crazy big percussion. Super danceable! High energy, without every getting the way. Useful for tech videos, badass characters, or general listenings! The download comes with all the parts separated out as well as a bonus track at 165 beats per minute (slightly slower and even deeper grooving!).

tracks.title: Divertimento K131
tracks.description: This is an arrangement of Mozart's Divertimento (K131) for bells, harp, chimes and celeste.  It is light and bouncy, with an accelerando around 45 seconds in.  The work is played two times.

tracks.title: Divertissement - Pizzicato (from the ballet Sylvia)
tracks.description: Delibes. I am astounded that there are so few recordings of this piece on the net... for a few reasons.    1. Everyone knows this piece (but nearly no one knows what it is called).    2. It is very easy to record (Pizzicato strings have been one of the few samples that have sounded "real" for a long time).    3. The composer is long dead and his stuff is in the Public Domain (Léo Delibes; 1891). And for some background... Sylvia is a 3-Act ballet first produced in 1876. I'm pretty certain this particular piece has nothing to do with the plot - or it wouldn't be called a "divertissement".

tracks.title: Division
tracks.instruments: Piano, Basses, Cellos, Flutes, Clarinets, Oboes, English Horn, Percussion
tracks.description: This is an awesome theme tune. For ANYthing. You got a dark comedy about an inept biologist? This will work. A gritty fantasy dealing with fairy politics? A sci-fi dystopian future where everyone likes sardines? A reality show about bicycle thieves? A  slice-of-life serial about growing up in the Upper Peninsula? Seriously. Anything.

tracks.title: Doh De Oh
tracks.description: Bass accompaniment only.

tracks.title: Doobly Doo
tracks.description: Thanks for watching. Like and subscribe. Comment below. Follow me on Facebook and Twitter. Join my professional network on linkedin. Check out my Bandcamp. Subscribe to my email newsletter. Circle me on whatever that Google thing is called. You'll like my Snapchat. Please enjoy my catalog of various Amazon boxes on Pintrest and Tumblr. Stop asking when I'm going to be back on Vine; I like Instragram video better now.

tracks.title: Dopplerette
tracks.description: Swift, abrupt ending.

tracks.title: Double Drift
tracks.description: Loads of delay on the guitar give this piece a dark, yet comforting feel. All of the sounds are rounded, but the effect isn't.

tracks.title: Double O
tracks.description: A weird medley containing synths.  Recorded beats throughout.  Starting at 1:30 human speech saying "Double O" is used.  Continues for the next 30 seconds.

tracks.title: Double Polka
tracks.description: Bouncy.

tracks.title: Dragon and Toast
tracks.instruments: Didge, Harp, Celesta, Bass, Cello, Violin, Bassoon, Conta Bassoon, English Horn, Oboe, Percussion
tracks.description: Minimalist-type piece.

tracks.title: Drankin Song
tracks.instruments: Violin, Bass, Guitar, Diddley Bow, Drums
tracks.description: You know those country sing-talking songs? This works GREAT for that. You can also use it for normal country songs. Anything where you need to express yourself about your truck, or losing your girl, or how awesome your mama was... Limitless possibilities! Also works fine by itself.

tracks.title: Dream Catcher
tracks.description: I'm not sure what "trap" music is exactly. I was trying to explain it to a friend and ended up writing this piece. I was listening to Lo-Fi Glitch at the time, which should explain a few things. Behold! Lo-Fi Trap! Dream Catcher! Get it? A Dream Catcher is a lo-fi trap! HAHAHHAHAhahaha! I already upgraded from a Dream Catcher to a Dream Glue Trap. You can get the dreams off with corn oil. They won't be happy. Wear thick gloves.

tracks.title: Dream Culture
tracks.description: Dreamy watery piano bits over a tight percussion with some reverse effects to add to the dreamlike state of things.

tracks.title: Dreamer
tracks.description: Gorgeous, rich piano chords run counter to subtle percussions. This piece is a workhouse for video productions. Don't bother with the preview, just download this thing. Because seriously... planning a cat rescue? This will work. Attending someone else's family reunion and trying to convince them you're related? Yes. This will work. Time lapse of a rocket assembly? Obviously. I'm looking at you, ESA!

tracks.title: Dreamlike
tracks.description: Dark, creepy theme with a modulation about 2/3 of the way in.

tracks.title: Dreams Become Real
tracks.description: Beautiful dreamy piece that confuses times and spaces. You really just need to take a moment and listen to this one - because it is really cool. How cool? You should probably find out! There are a lot of extra synth things going on in it that are hidden in and amongst the piano, like one of those hidden picture books with 45 paperclips, but you can only ever see 7 of them.

tracks.title: Dreamy Flashback
tracks.description: This piece features repetitive triplet arpeggi and a lydian scale to invoke a dreamy feel.  Staccato instruments add to the piece's mystery.  The pattern is a continuous loop between two arpeggiated chords.

tracks.title: Drone in D
tracks.description: A very long piece of highly relaxing music - done as mostly a piano impromptu over a simple drone (very long note). The piece is in the key of D... mostly. (usually, there is an F sharp and C sharp - this uses an F sharp and B flat... there is no name for this that I know of)

tracks.title: Drums of the Deep
tracks.description: Moody and atmospheric with a hint of power.

tracks.title: Dub Eastern
tracks.description: Some sort of freakish fusion. No, I don't know what the heck that synth is supposed to be emulating.

tracks.title: Dub Feral
tracks.description: Moog-tastic swooping synth played through a crappy guitar amp over the top of a mid-tempo dub groove.

tracks.title: Dubakupado
tracks.description: Named for the sound of the final cadence. This is a nice solid grooving piece - light on polyrhythm -  for 8 percussionists.

tracks.title: Duet Musette
tracks.description: Folk sounds from the continent. This is not a traditional anything, just improvisation in two chords.

tracks.title: Dvorak Polka
tracks.description: Actual instruments - not the normal electronic ones.

tracks.title: Earnest
tracks.description: 6/8 apreggiations with a thin high melody.

tracks.title: Earth Prelude
tracks.description: Grounding background pad with melodic interest. Think "grassy plains".

tracks.title: East of Tunesia
tracks.instruments: Percussion, and... I'm not sure what else.
tracks.description: Sort of based on Maltesian music. The primary horn in this piece is actually an effected sopranino sax with an oboe drone.

tracks.title: Eastern Thought
tracks.description: Moderately relaxed, moderately intense, very eastern.

tracks.title: Eastminster
tracks.description: The constant reverberating sound of rain and the perfect-fifth drone of the strings are calming, but have an air of suspense and tension about them, as if a drama is about to unfold. The koto plays a near continuous refrain, at times forcefully. Evoking pre-colonialist East Asia, the piece is beautiful and stoic in tone, especially as the koto asserts its dominance in the sixth minute and at the end.

tracks.title: Easy Jam
tracks.instruments: Bass, Kit, Guitar, Trumpet, Trombone, Flute
tracks.description: Chilled out reggae with a brass section.

tracks.title: Easy Lemon
tracks.description: Super non-offending little piece. Takes voice-over very well. Available in several lengths.

tracks.title: Easy Lemon (30 second)
tracks.description: Super non-offending little piece. Takes voice-over very well. Available in several lengths.

tracks.title: Easy Lemon (60 second)
tracks.description: Super non-offending little piece. Takes voice-over very well. Available in several lengths.

tracks.title: Ebbs and Flows
tracks.description: Oh no! The dolphin has an ethereal choir stuck in her blow-hole! Someone get the extractor tool, quick!

tracks.title: Echoes of Time
tracks.description: Deep, rich, and thick soundscape with semi-tonal bells.

tracks.title: Echoes of Time v2
tracks.description: Deep, rich, and thick soundscape but without the bells melody.

tracks.title: EDM Detection Mode
tracks.description: This is a sort of electronic music with a heavy backbeat and thumpin' bass. There is a significant change in theme at around 2 minutes - so if the beginning is a bit boring, you can start there. There is another fun change at around 3:30. If you didn't like the previous bits, just start there! I think you get the picture.

tracks.title: Egmont Overture
tracks.feel: Dark, Epic, Intense, Mysterious, Somber, Uplifting
tracks.description: Written by Beethoven. The original source recordings for this come from MusOpen (and are available for free!). This mix is slightly augmented, and highly produced in a cinematic style.

tracks.title: Egmont Overture Finale
tracks.description: Written by Beethoven. The original source recordings for this come from MusOpen (and are available for free!). This mix is slightly augmented, and highly produced in a cinematic style.

tracks.title: Eighties Action
tracks.description: Super 1980's-style synth action. Something like one might intro a sports team to, or maybe a late-night radio show. It picks up about 1/3 of the way in...

tracks.title: El Magicia
tracks.description: Every now and again I get a request that is so odd, I have to try it. This is hard driving guitar rock with traditional Spanish flair. Imagine Chriss Angel meets Los Del Rio for an in-your-face Spanish/stage magic performance. Thick and busy.

tracks.title: Electro (Sketch)
tracks.description: This is NOT a complete piece. It is only a sketch developed as a test for a stage production (repeated many times).  If you only need a few seconds, it is fine. Smooth rich synths fill in a nice syncopated hook.

tracks.title: Electro Cabello
tracks.instruments: Drums, Ukulele, Trumpet, Trombone, Tenor Sax, Synths
tracks.description: Put all the happy things in a blender, and what do you get? Disco-Salsa-Ukulele-Melange.

tracks.title: Electrodoodle
tracks.description: Yeah, it is happy. Yeah, it is simple. Yeah, there are... rhythmic things going on. How will you use this? honestly, I have no clue.

tracks.title: Elf Meditation
tracks.description: What is meditation for one may be cause for concern in another. - Some Elf

tracks.title: Enchanted Journey
tracks.description: A harp solo in several distinct sections. It works well as a contained piece, but also contains several smaller sections that stand alone.

tracks.title: Enchanted Valley
tracks.instruments: Celesta, Clarinet, Flute, Alto Flute, Bass Clarinet, Violins, Cellos
tracks.description: Nice light little piece.

tracks.title: End of the Era
tracks.description: Alto Flute along with the low brass in the beginning, switching to strings. Final sounds are more harsh than the beginning. Ends with a tiny flourish.

tracks.title: Energizing
tracks.description: Purity is the word! Start your day with energy from this piece. Recommend you set it as your alarm!

tracks.title: Enigma
tracks.description: Written as a theme for a podcast, this was requested as "upbeat with an air of mystery". So that's what it is.

tracks.title: Enter the Maze
tracks.description: A thumping bass note intermingles with metallic noises to create a feeling of tension and terror. Screeching synth noises enter occasionally, and after a shrill screaming lead, the percussion is sparse but nerve-racking.

tracks.title: Enter the Party
tracks.description: Simple, clean, light-yet-driving funk-type dance.

tracks.title: Envision
tracks.description: There is a mystery that is unfolding, unraveling, being solved, confounding, being thought about, being copied, demanding attention, delighting, comforting, and feeding the dog treats that look like sausages and get your hands all oily. Best for: Feature films where the protagonist thinks about a hard problem while walking at night in the neon-bathed entertainment district in Osaka in the rain in 1994.

tracks.title: Epic Unease
tracks.description: Starts quiet, ends fortissimo brass.

tracks.title: Equatorial Complex
tracks.description:
Enjoy a serene sanctuary where time stands still. Envelop yourself in a warm, nostalgic embrace, evoking the feeling of a sun-drenched afternoon in a hidden garden. The air is filled with the echoes of a distant, yet familiar, world, inviting you to lose yourself in the comforting simplicity of the moment...


Synthwave textures weave an intricate matrix around you, leaving you entangled in its cybernetic allure. Deck in, chummer, and let the futuristic soundscape rewrite your reality. Wait... what universe is this set in?

tracks.title: Errigal
tracks.description: Celtic-sounding solo piece with a sort of drone bass line, apreggios, and a forte melody.

tracks.title: Eternal Hope
tracks.instruments: Piano, Strings, Helicon, French Horn, Choir
tracks.description: Building hopeful piece. Supported piano solo.

tracks.title: Eternal Terminal
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Basses, Bass Clarinet, Tubas, Trombones, Clarinets, Flutes, Oboes, French Horns
tracks.description: I like the waterphone in this piece. It is a bunch of metal tubes welded together, and played with a bow. It is that creepy high-pitched thing you hear in horror movies all the time.

tracks.title: Eternity
tracks.description: This is like... the ultimate in high-class non-offensive music. You can have this going at the hippest highest-class hotel in the world, and it'll feel at home. You can also put in less-classy places to make them feel classier! Like the opium den you built in your garage, or that tiny closet at your office where lunch-room recyclables go to get sticky and smell bad. I mean seriously... I don't think they ALL started out sticky.

tracks.title: Ether Disco
tracks.instruments: Kit, Bass, Wah Guitar, Strings, Glock
tracks.description: More subdued bassline, and some fun glockenspiel action. Some synth drum hits.

tracks.title: Ether Vox
tracks.instruments: Drums, Electric Piano, Guitar, Synths, Vocals
tracks.description: What do you get when you cross Phil Collins and Enya? You get a visit from the ethics department, and you get your funding revoked.

tracks.title: Ethereal Relaxation
tracks.description: Meditation Tips: 1) Get comfortable. Maybe try sitting on a chair, or the ground. 2) Breathe. Why are you holding your breath? That won't help. 3) Relax. Stop fighting the bear. You two can fight later. 4) Close your eyes. Meditation is less effective if you have toothpicks holding your eyes open. 5) Minimize distractions. Turn off all your sirens and strobe lights.  Why? Why do you even have sirens!? The bear I can understand, but why SO MANY SIRENS!?

tracks.title: Ethernight Club
tracks.description: 2am. It is raining and there is a line outside the noodle place. A dim red glow comes up from the next staircase down; you hear a hypnotic pulse. Looking down, you see there's a propped-open door with a couple smoking outside it. "Ethernight Club" is laser cut into a piece of old roofing metal.  If you walk down the stairs to "Ethernight Club"", turn to page 13. If you decide to get noodles at ????, turn to page 42.

tracks.title: Evening
tracks.description: Hey Music Supervisors! Are you sick of choosing Claude Debussy's "Clair de Lune" or Ravel's "Pavane for a Dead Princess" when you're placing music for that one scene at the end of Act II where there is a sunset and an overall sense of relief? I got ya, friend!

tracks.title: Evening Fall (Harp)
tracks.description: Harp "duet"... where the harps never actually play together. Impromptu

tracks.title: Evening Fall (Piano)
tracks.description: Impromptu

tracks.title: Evening Melodrama
tracks.instruments: French Horn, Trombones, Trumpet, Triangle, Violins, Cellos, Basses, Tympani, Snare, Flute, Clarinet
tracks.description: Theme for a 1980's-esque prime time TV melodrama.

tracks.title: Evening of Chaos
tracks.instruments: Piano, Percussion, Synths, Strings, Brass, Glock
tracks.description: Semi-beautiful and flawed piano melody contrasts with industrial percussion.

tracks.title: Ever Mindful
tracks.instruments: Cellos, Basses, Violas, Violins, Choir, Flutes, Clarinets
tracks.description: A different kind of relaxing piece with long but detailed harmonic complexity. I personally have a hard time with the drone-type of relaxing music. It doesn't work for me. This one gives your mind something to think about... very very slowly.

tracks.title: Evil March
tracks.description: Description pending.

tracks.title: Evil Plan
tracks.description: Melody in the bass. Dark, but still energetic.

tracks.title: Exciting Trailer
tracks.feel: Action, Aggressive, Dark, Driving, Epic, Intense
tracks.description: A militaristic snare drum march begins this piece, reminiscent of Eastern Europe during World War II. The orchestral sounds blend with the sharpness of the brass throughout, but especially after 0:36, when the music is lyrical and melodic, though intensely emotional and suspenseful. At 0:52, the rhythmic march begins again, with the strings playing the melody and the brass reaching discordant, swelling heights until the final crescendo at 1:10.

tracks.title: Exhilarate
tracks.description: Exuberant and precise rock piece.

tracks.title: Exit the Premises
tracks.description: Big drums start with piece to reveal that they were not establishing the downbeat. Tight synth percussion and 8-bit inspired synths make this piece downright danceable! And who doesn't like a giant 80s synth? Or a 90s chip tunes synth? Or a modern synth? We gots them all!

tracks.title: Exotic Battle
tracks.description: Definite African influence on this mostly orchestral piece. Clean ending.

tracks.title: Exotics
tracks.description: Epic piano playing against world percussion and acid-style synths with an upbeat beat.

tracks.title: Expeditionary
tracks.description: A sort of African/European salad mix of sounds.

tracks.title: Eyes Gone Wrong
tracks.description: How wrong? Guess you'll need to find out.

tracks.title: Facile
tracks.description: Slow, deliberate piano solo - ending on a very satisfying Tierce de Picardie.

tracks.title: Failing Defense
tracks.description: This piece begins immediately with horn blasts, strings, and a bone-jangling xylophone. After the brief intro the horns play a melody, then the horns drop away away except tribal drums and staccato string bursts. The music returns in a big way, suggestive of a tense battle, as the instruments compete against each other, until the rapid discordant end.

tracks.title: Fairytale Waltz
tracks.description: Written as an overture to (of all things) a fairy tale musical - this piece stands well on its own.

tracks.title: Fanfare for Space
tracks.description: A take-off on Strauss' Zarathustra theme that is legal for use in every country. Because I wrote it, and I said so.

tracks.title: Fantasia Fantasia
tracks.description: On your journey to the Southern Oracle, you will pass many wondrous things indeed! The Morning Meal Guild, The Highest Possible Weapon, and The Dancer of Flashes all await. Never give up and good luck will find you.

tracks.title: Fantastic Dim Bar
tracks.description: I knew I'd find a use for the subtle demonic piano! Short impromptu, dim and dark.

tracks.title: Farm
tracks.description: Farm is part of a 4-part video game experience.  You can experience “Farm” here: https://incompetech.com/games/Magic%20Scout/ It even works on most phones!  TIP! Crops regrow faster than weeds.  TIP! Once a rock is magicked away, it is gone forever. Stay clear if you want to keep it!

tracks.title: Farting Around
tracks.description: Every generation has its masterpiece; Bach's Brandenburg Concertos, Beethoven's 9th Symphony, Rossini's "William Tell". This is such a piece. For nearly one minute, "Farting Around" will transport you to a new world. A world of unadulterated joy. A world of pure farts.

tracks.title: Fast Talkin
tracks.description: Noir. Private detective from the 1940's sort of feel.

tracks.title: Faster Does It
tracks.description: Fast-paced and frenetic, the acoustic bass plays in every register available to the instrument, while the drum kit is chaotic and harried. You know... Bebop.

tracks.title: Fearless First
tracks.description: Before you complain about the bass, that is the entire point of this mix. It is scary-bass... yet somehow subdued. If this bass was a car, it would be a cement mixer... That's a terrible analogy. Forgetting for the moment that a cement mixer isn't a car... I guess they have the ones that are mounted on big trucks - and those trucks share a lot in common with cars, you know steering wheels, engines, tires, and the soon-to-be-anachronistic internal combustion engine. Anyway, if you don't like the bass you can pretty easily EQ it to a reasonable level, or buy the stems and remix it yourownself. Before you complain about the use of the word "yourownself", I wrote it. You understood it. It is a word. There is also some dreamy flute in here.

tracks.title: Feelin Good
tracks.description: A super-peppy mindless strumming feel-good sort of piece.

tracks.title: Feral Angel Waltz
tracks.description: Featuring the genuine Nordic Metal talents of Alexander Nakarada. This is a thing the Viennese would totally dance to... if they were MUCH more angry than average Wiener. I'm looking at you, Gunther!

tracks.title: Feral Chase
tracks.instruments: Bass, Cello, Viola, Tympani, Marimba, Flutes
tracks.description: Someone's running from something... or to somewhere... High energy, but reserved.

tracks.title: Fiddles McGinty
tracks.instruments: Uilleann Pipes, Recorder, Guitar, Bass, Percussion
tracks.description: Jig? Reel? Hornpipe? I don't know!

tracks.title: Fife and Drum
tracks.description: Welcome to Historic Williamsburg! Nestled between "That's-OK Greenpoint" and "Still-Kinda-Frightening-In-Many-Areas Bushwick", Historic Williamsburg offers you a link to the past that you'll love! Trucker hats, coffee shops, mustache wax, artisanal mac+cheese, used book stores - come experience part of America's Past! And when you're done; "Get the 'L out of Williamsburg!" [ *L may not be running. ]

tracks.title: Fig Leaf Rag
tracks.description: The classic ragtime ditty of Scott Joplin, perfect for a silent film of whimsy and humor. The piece begins with a short intro, then plays the bouncy rhythm of with a bright plodding beat. At the end of the third minute, the pace quickens, and leads into a darker refrain, but the jolly melody returns for the finale.

tracks.title: Fig Leaf Rag - distressed
tracks.description: The classic ragtime ditty of Scott Joplin, perfect for a silent film of whimsy and humor. The piece begins with a short intro, then plays the bouncy rhythm of with a bright plodding beat. At the end of the third minute, the pace quickens, and leads into a darker refrain, but the jolly melody returns for the finale.  With added record player effects.

tracks.title: Fig Leaf Times Two
tracks.description: My first true Baroom Piano sound. chorusing detuned on the upper strings. Very warm sound.

tracks.title: Final Battle of the Dark Wizards
tracks.instruments: Synths, Choir, Percussion, French Horns, Trumpets, Violas
tracks.description: Slowly building tension power that really gets going when the super gnarly drums kick in after the violas... sort of in the section with the trumpet.... then there's this part that's all like "AHHHH AHHHHHH AAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!!" And then there's some more "AHHHHHHHHH" and then even more and its like a new key or something, and the drums are all distorted and slammin', and then there's this wwwwwwhhhhHHHHHOOOOOOOSHHHH!!!! and some more french horn majesty - and like another keychange or something... but definitely some bass drum. The big bass drum that you stand up and hit with a mallet... not the kind you stick on the floor... and stomp on a pedal that is attached to a mallet that hits the floor drum.

tracks.title: Final Count
tracks.feel: Action, Dark, Epic, Intense, Somber, Unnerving
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Piano, Choir, Orchestra, Pipe Organ
tracks.description: Epic piece taking off from Chopin's famous funeral march (Piano Sonata #2). Death! Death! Death!

tracks.title: Finding Movement
tracks.description: The koto in this piece follows a steady, plodding beat, while the orchestral strings provide a drone-like background. At 0:33 the strings crescendo to follow the melody of the koto, but at 1:18 the tempo slows and the strings fade away, only to return to highlight the final chord.  With the even rhythm and the sharply accentuated plucks of the koto, this is best used as an introduction to a short film or game, or the resolution to a conflict surrounding family or challenges to tradition.

tracks.title: Finding the Balance
tracks.description: The beginning is calm with the Middle Eastern dudek playing the melody. As the electronic elements melt into the dudek and the plucked strings, the groove is established.  Just into the third minute the melody changes to beautiful and touching, but returns to the feel of the intro, while a woman?s voice sings a haunting melody in a distant language. This is music of wonder, and is best as exposition music for a film about nature or a group of people struggling to survive.

tracks.title: Fire Prelude
tracks.description: Edgy/calm background music. Synth pads with some orchestral textures.

tracks.title: Firebrand
tracks.description: Super fast percussive piece with polynesian rhythms mixed with a fusion of large modern drums.

tracks.title: Fireflies and Stardust
tracks.instruments: Banjo, Violins, Mandolin, Guitars, Bass, Drums
tracks.description: Some beautiful rural americana-type music. I mean, just listen to that!  It is an 8 piece ensemble, and everyone is playing a lot of notes, yet it remains so simple.  Okay, the violins aren't playing that many notes... had to pick up the 2nd violin off the waiver wires, and there wasn't enough time to get her up to speed on the offense for this piece. So we made an executive decision, and kept things simple. We should still be able to get some good yardage here, and hope to win on defense.

tracks.title: Firesong
tracks.description: Native American drumming with a deep dark drive. Slowly picks up in speed throughout.

tracks.title: Firmament
tracks.description: An interesting mix of rock, reggae with a more than average bit of swing to it. Three distinct snare drums give it character.

tracks.title: First Call
tracks.description: AKA "Warning Call". Three trumpeter version of the 1804 military bugle call. I couldn't get the ensemble to do triple tonguing on the arpeggios. Oh well. Still does the job. Get ready!

tracks.title: Five Armies
tracks.feel: Action, Aggressive, Dark, Driving, Epic, Intense
tracks.instruments: Cellos, French Horns, Trombones, Violins, Marimba, Trumpets, Percussion, Oboes, Clarinets, Flutes, Basses
tracks.description: Big giant building piece starting in 6/4 alternating to 4/4 and back. Soaring ending with a lot of brass.

tracks.title: Five Card Shuffle
tracks.description: Walkin' along blues shuffle. Accellerates beginning to end.

tracks.title: Flighty Theme
tracks.instruments: Flute, Clarinet, Bass, Clarinet, Snare, Basses
tracks.description: Fun little piece played very poorly.

tracks.title: Floating Cities
tracks.description: It is the future? It certainly sounds like it... What would I use this for? Probably a video game with non-action gameplay. Certainly a montage of some futuristic film... or maybe one of those sandwiched scenes where a person is walking in the rain, but you don't get any of the sounds of the actual rain... just this piece. No dialog, no voiceover, just walking. Do they have a name for those scenes? They must.

tracks.title: Fluffing a Duck
tracks.instruments: Tuba, Flute, Trombones, Bass Clarinet, Clarinet, Percussion
tracks.description: A trombone plays a humorous melody alongside timpanis and a variety of woodwind instruments. This music is suited for a short theme for a comedic piece that relies on visual jokes.  2 Small versions in one file.

tracks.title: Fluidscape
tracks.description: Very long, cool, relaxed piece - no surprises, though the timbre does change from time to time.

tracks.title: Flutey Funk
tracks.description: Starts off strong with bass, kit and flute.  Flute taking melody throughout the piece.  Bass and kit in the background throughout, however bass is prominent over kit.

tracks.title: Flutey Sting
tracks.description: Slight slow down in tempo on the end.

tracks.title: Flying Kerfuffle
tracks.description: Happy happy, happy happiness. Happier, happiest? Happy. Now that the word has lost all meaning, take a listen to this thing. It is dripping with joy. Ever see a sad person on a jetski? Of course not. It isn't possible. Similarly, you can't listen to this and be sad. No Mortal Can! You can be angry at it, you can dislike it, but you can't be sad because of it. What happens when you employ modern club music techniques on music for folk dances? This.

tracks.title: Folk Round
tracks.instruments: Guitar, Violin, Recorder, Piccolo, Percussion, Accordion
tracks.description: A simple folk perpetual canon - also known as a round. Feels like a medieval campfire piece.

tracks.title: For Originz
tracks.description: Heavy strings play several chords before a violin enters with a sliding melody, in tandem with a woman?s voice and flute. The bass drums are barely perceptible, but accentuate the orchestra as the three melodic personalities float amongst the music. The music is full of wonder and power, and ends in a strong chord, evoking a connection with nature.

tracks.title: For the Fallen
tracks.description: Beginning with beautiful symphonic chords accentuated by a glockenspiel, For The Fallen builds gently and with emotion. At the mid-point, marching drums build in and the music strikes a more serious tone, retaining its dramatic passion.

tracks.title: Fork and Spoon
tracks.description: Super-funky organ piece.

tracks.title: Four Beers' Polka
tracks.instruments: Kit, Trumpet, Clarinet, Sax, Bass, Electric Guitar, Accordion
tracks.description: Full polka ensemble. She's a peppy one, she is. Instrumental.

tracks.title: Freddy's Menagerie
tracks.description: Fast chaotic piece in 3 sections. Almost rock, almost African, almost soundtrack material - this is a very useful piece in many applications.

tracks.title: Fresh Air
tracks.description: This was a quick improvisation that turned out pretty listenable! Original title was "Sofa King Beautiful", but I figured "Fresh Air" worked better. Since this is a piece for solo keyboard, I included four alternate keyboards in the uncompressed download. They all have subtly different feels. Electric Piano, Grand Piano, Spinet Piano (out of tune), and a piano where you tap the strings rather than hit it with the hammers.

tracks.title: Fretless
tracks.instruments: Guitar, Ukulele, Drums, Bass, Glockenspiel, Music Box
tracks.description: Nice, forward-pulling piece pretty much guaranteed to offend no one. This piece is a little more complex than others in this genre because of the multiple countermelodies. They clear out many times, and make room before coming back in. You can make your own mixes with the uncompressed downloads to only include the melodies you want if you like!

tracks.title: Friday Morning
tracks.description: Simple, calm, open piano impromptu.

tracks.title: Friendly Day
tracks.description: Most famously used in the film "Hugo".

tracks.title: Frogs Legs Rag
tracks.description: James Scott composition.

tracks.title: Frost Waltz
tracks.instruments: Celesta, Glockenspiel, Basses, Cellos, Violas, Violins, French Horns,
tracks.description: A calm buy mysterious composition that uses Glockenspiel and Celesta throughout.  French Horns and Bass intercede throughout to accompany the Glockenspiel and Celesta.  Violin and Viola in the background throughout the piece.

tracks.title: Frost Waltz (Alternate)
tracks.description: This is alternate take of "Frost Waltz." It features arpeggiated bells and strings oscillating gently between minor chords.

tracks.title: Frozen Star
tracks.description: Lilting gentle feel with odd chord progressions.

tracks.title: Full On
tracks.feel: Action, Aggressive, Dark, Driving, Epic, Intense
tracks.instruments: Cellos, French Horns, Trombones, Violins, Percussion, Basses
tracks.description: Lots of little sections ending with soaring horns. Who doesn't like that?

tracks.title: Fun in a Bottle
tracks.description: Peppy piano piece that has a tinge of darkness, but is always happy!

tracks.title: Funeral March for Brass
tracks.description: A simple new funeral march; atypical in the fleeting moments of triumph.

tracks.title: Funin and Sunin
tracks.description: Deep and round-sounding beach-themed piece. It can be used for non-beach applications. Not to be used internally. May cause rashes.

tracks.title: Funk Game Loop
tracks.description: Looping section of a backgroundy piece of music. It says it is a game loop, but you can loop it for anything you like.

tracks.title: Funkorama
tracks.description: Clean audio mix with an interesting electronic drum kit and odd chord progressions. Nice grooving bass line.

tracks.title: Funky Boxstep
tracks.description: This is certainly a challenge to waltz to, but it is possible! Might be better for other dances in 3/4? I've never heard funk like this before, and it feels more "off" than it actually is.

tracks.title: Funky Chunk
tracks.instruments: Bass, EP, Drums, Guitar, Synth, Horns
tracks.description: Get down with the 'get down'! A very clean sort of funk thing. Appropriate for a widevariety of exciting sorts of things, including funky dance parties, car washing (dance parties), barbecuing (dance parties), and colonoscopy (dance parties).

tracks.title: Funky One
tracks.description: Kind of a funky-sounding beat.

tracks.title: Furious Freak
tracks.description: Starts thin and explodes suddenly and massively around the 44-second mark. The uncompressed download also comes with a cut where it starts out big. I'm assuming it will be used for the outro parts of videos.

tracks.title: Future Cha Cha
tracks.description: Almost disco, almost techno, almost falls apart (but it doesn't). Dance, dance, dance. It feels like a piece that you'd kick off a party with. Lots and lots of bass. Solid 140BPM for mixing goodness.

tracks.title: Future Gladiator
tracks.feel: Aggressive, Dark, Driving, Epic, Mysterious, Unnerving
tracks.description: Might be soundtrack, might be unclassifiable... pieces like this, I just can't ever tell. Nothing tricksy going on here - just forward motion.

tracks.title: Fuzzball Parade
tracks.description: Dear music directors and music supervisors, You're welcome. How was this track never produced by anyone before? It is here now and available to license at a very reasonable fee.

tracks.title: Gagool
tracks.description: A very nice piece with repeated themes... not sure what one should expect, given the instrumentation of this piece - but it probably won't disappoint.

tracks.title: Galactic Rap
tracks.description: The cool thing about these kinds of pieces is that they leave a lot of room for your own creativity. It is 98% voice-over friendly! Talk all you want over the top of this piece! But watch out for the key change at 1:34... it will steal attention.

tracks.title: Galway
tracks.description: Come in and listen to some high-energy Irish-like drinking music in an authentic pub! Not one of those clean American things that say they are "Irish pubs", but a proper Irish pub with tiny windows that are too high to see out of and thick dark carpeting that always smells like old beer.

tracks.title: Garden Music
tracks.description: This epic 41-minute relaxing juggernaut is a continually changing yet always pleasant piece. How pleasant? Very, very pleasant. You can just put this one on and drift away to the imagined utopian land of your choosing! Suitable for day-spa background music, dental office calming music, very long form landscape or train videos, governmental intake and processing videos. The uncompressed download does not contain separate files, just the one big 650 meg wav file.

tracks.title: Gaslamp Funworks
tracks.instruments: Machines, Brass, Organ, Cellos, Percussion, Glock, Xylophone
tracks.description: It is 1895, you just got your new brass-rimmed monocle, and you want to head out to see the new gigantic music machine that was just constructed... Roaring 1920s fun, 1930s art music style bridge... it is the retro future of music.

tracks.title: Gathering Darkness
tracks.description: Screeching dark, electronically chattery. Nightmarish.

tracks.title: Gearhead
tracks.description: A slow and rockin' piece with chunking distorted guitar with a confident and laid-back beat.

tracks.title: George Street Shuffle
tracks.description: Nice little non-offending light jazz piece for vibes.

tracks.title: Getting it Done
tracks.description: Extremely satisfying sound design with super clean bloopy synths in a light dance context. Recommended for all your needs. Unless you need a fire suppression system. It won't work for that. Unless you need music for your fire suppression system. It will work for that.

tracks.title: Ghost Dance
tracks.description: 6/8 piece with piano intro that leads into a sparse orchestral, and ends with piano again.

tracks.title: Ghost Processional
tracks.instruments: Orchestral - Bass, Cello, Violin, Celesta, Bells
tracks.description: Scant few cellos and bassists play pizzicato under celesta, bells, and violins in this slow and careful piece. The extra string tag on the end is not intended as part of the piece, it is included for use stand-alone in foreshadowing in video editing.

tracks.title: Ghost Processional (digitally processed)
tracks.instruments: Orchestral - Bass, Cello, Violin, Celesta, Bells, Wind, Cymbal
tracks.description: Scant few cellos and bassists play pizzicato under celesta, bells, and violins in this slow and careful piece. The extra string tag on the end is not intended as part of the piece, it is included for use stand-alone in foreshadowing in video editing.

tracks.title: Ghost Story
tracks.description: Spooky piece, slow moving in 2 parts written for 4 percussionists. Second movement starts at 2:30.

tracks.title: Ghostpocalypse - 1 Departure
tracks.description: 1 of 8 in Ghostpocalypse. 100% atmospheric. No melodic or rhythmic elements.

tracks.title: Ghostpocalypse - 2 The Call
tracks.description: 2 of 8. Some dark and low rhythmic elements. Some bits of piano.

tracks.title: Ghostpocalypse - 3 Road of Trials
tracks.description: 3 of 8. Odd phrasing and counterpoints.

tracks.title: Ghostpocalypse - 4 Temptress
tracks.description: 4 of 8. Driving slower rhythm with piano.

tracks.title: Ghostpocalypse - 5 Apotheosis
tracks.description: 5 of 8. Feverish build near the midway point.

tracks.title: Ghostpocalypse - 6 Crossing the Threshold
tracks.description: 6 of 8. Waltz-like theme.

tracks.title: Ghostpocalypse - 7 Master
tracks.description: 7 of 8. This is the giant percussive piece of the series. Break in the middle, resumes fast to the end.

tracks.title: Ghostpocalypse - 8 Epilog
tracks.description: 8 of 8. Quirky little solo for 2 pianos and one player.

tracks.title: Giant Wyrm
tracks.description: Oh! The horror! This is NOT a fun piece. It WILL make you feel like there is something seriously wrong. Did those veins on my forearm always look like that? I mean, they're doing a weird criss-cross pattern... and they look REALLY blue. I would have noticed that before, surely! I wonder if this has anything to do with the  meteor that came down in Mr. Wilson's pond last night? Uncompressed download comes with 4 stem files in case you don't need all the creepy, all the time.

tracks.title: Glee Club Polka
tracks.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Kit, Trumpets, Clarinet, Sax
tracks.description: High-energy polka with screaming trumpets and a clarinet "voice". Modulation at the end. Unusual turnarounds.

tracks.title: Glitter Blast
tracks.description: Ukulele and flutes and glockenspiel... I think you already know what this sounds like. The percussion is also adorable.

tracks.title: Gloom Horizon
tracks.description: Mournful piece with a nice melody. Melody starts at 40 seconds in. Feel free to chop out as much opening as is required. The low beat is a bass drum with the attacks cut off.

tracks.title: Gnarled Situation
tracks.instruments: Xylophone, Choir, Organ, Strings, Percussion, Flutes
tracks.description: Builds with a climax, then calm ending in flutes.

tracks.title: Go Cart
tracks.description: Beautifully clean piece with a nasty edge. First bass drop at 58 seconds.

tracks.title: Go Cart - Drop Mix
tracks.description: Beautifully clean piece with a nasty edge. This version starts out thick.

tracks.title: Go Cart - Loop Mix
tracks.description: Beautifully clean piece with a nasty edge. This version loops seamlessly back to the beginning (mostly for use in video games).

tracks.title: Goblin Tinker Soldier Spy
tracks.instruments: Tuba, Percussion, Bass, Melodica, Drums, Marimba
tracks.description: "Ya wants ta make things? Piles of things? Make things wit us Goblins! We got sticks and hammers and pokies. You get ta hit things wit udder things. If ya hit a rat, ya gets more stew! If ya hits da stew, ya get hit with rats."   Teamwork! Steady Progress! Shinies! Work with Goblins today!

tracks.title: Gold Rush
tracks.description: Peppy piano duet.

tracks.title: Golly Gee
tracks.description: 1950's sit-com-like theme song.

tracks.title: Gone Beyond
tracks.description: The child-like music box is the constant in this piece, but the repetition of the melody shifts from innocence to the music of a character detached from life, on the verge of psychoses or paranoia. The choir in the background lends the music a heavenly, albeit sepulchral feel.

tracks.title: Gonna Start
tracks.description: Grungy sounding early reggae type groove. This piece is also available in a faster 90 beats per minute version.

tracks.title: Gonna Start v2
tracks.description: Grungy sounding early reggae type groove. This piece is also available in a slower 73 beats per minute version.

tracks.title: Got Funk
tracks.description: For the gentleman rhymer; funk with a bigger beat and aged effects on piano and horns.

tracks.title: Gothamlicious
tracks.description: Modern cinematic tension.

tracks.title: Grammophone Taps
tracks.description: Warning - this is played wrong...

tracks.title: Grand Dark Waltz Allegretto
tracks.instruments: Piano, Cellos, Violas, Flute, Celeste, Trumpet, French Horn, Kit
tracks.description: Whilst learning to waltz, I noticed that the music wasn't flowing exactly with the explanations of how to move - so I fixed it. This piece overemphasizes the first beat with a hard slide in on the downbeat. Should make it easier for beginners to understand what is going on. The are 3 tempos to practice different styles of waltz, or just work up to the fast one!
