tracks.title: Grave Blow
tracks.description: We're dealing with a dark tragedy here... sounds like something needs to be done!

tracks.title: Grave Matters
tracks.description: Methodical and depressing short piece. Written as a quick composition study with only strings.

tracks.title: Graveyard Shift
tracks.description: SpoooooOOoooky! Nothing says comedically spooky quite like a theramin. I don't actually own a theramin, so I cheated. Like I do. This one was created with the ES2 synth, which everyone I know hates and/or fears. It really is just misunderstood, and is quite lovely at parties.

tracks.title: Gregorian Chant
tracks.description: Is it a real Gregorian Chant? Nope. For one - there are no real words in it. Honestly, I don't want a religious exaltation mucking up my fantasy world. So if you're building a historically accurate "Monk Simulator: Year of Our Lord 882!", just move on. The other reason this isn't real is I never learned how to read that notation. There are insufficient sticks for the rhythms in the notation... I know, there is a real convention that you can learn. I just grabbed a few pieces of the sheet music from the 1200s, and guessed at how to do it. Sounds reasonable enough to me! (says the guy who knows virtually nothing about the art)

tracks.title: Greko (Sketch)
tracks.description: This is NOT a complete piece. It is only a sketch developed as a test for a stage production (repeated many times).  If you only need a few seconds, it is fine. This is a hybrid of latin, greek, and R+B... as best I can figure.

tracks.title: Greta Sting
tracks.description: A somber orchestral sting with a gentle rising motion.

tracks.title: Grim Idol
tracks.instruments: Basses, Cellos, Violas, Violins, Flutes, Clarinets, Oboes, Organs, Percussion, Cimbasso, Trombones
tracks.description: This piece gets a lot of its crazy from the exposed dissonances. So, before you start going on and on about "wrong" notes; They are there for a reason! I'm almost sure of it. They really sound quite intentional. Why else would I write something like that? Totally done with forethought. Yup. 100% on purpose.

tracks.title: Grim League
tracks.description: This all drum ensemble will convey the gravity of the situation; Funeral, speech about a battle plan, the importance of tungsten. Anything with weight.

tracks.title: Griphop
tracks.description: Sort of hip-hop rap beat with a giant backing string section.

tracks.title: Groove Grove
tracks.description: Background music for ethereal storytelling. It maintains interest, without driving and usurping attention away from the story or visuals.

tracks.title: Groundwork
tracks.description: Stop it! Stop complaining, it is supposed to end like that! This is a loopable piece. Why? You never know how long your voice-overed tour of the cardboard factory is going to take... Or your real estate tour... Or your appendectomy video... Or your video of that one train by your house. Uncompressed download comes with a faster version, and a slower version.

tracks.title: Guess Who
tracks.instruments: Piano, Harpsichord, Electric Guitar, Cellos, Bassoons, Oboe, Glock, Drum Kit
tracks.description: Bizarre mix of orchestral setting with a power guitar and drum set.

tracks.title: Guiton Sketch
tracks.description: Very short and energetic piece - but it can be easily looped, the end lines up perfectly with the beginning.

tracks.title: Gustav Sting
tracks.description: A grooving sting featuring percussion and low staccato strings.

tracks.title: Guts and Bourbon
tracks.description: Country... rural... upbeat...

tracks.title: Guzheng City
tracks.description: Welcome to "Hotel Lobbies Around the World"! Here in Guzheng City, this hotel lobby features flaming brasiers offset the triple 10 meter waterfalls.  An innovative clock made of animatronic dolphins sets the tone, while telling the time! 6 Artist alcoves on the opposite wall provide guests with entertainment while providing the artists customers! Next week, we will take a look at a very special taxidermy-themed lobby in Cudahy, Wisconsin.

tracks.title: Gymnopedie No. 1
tracks.description: Elegant and slightly dark, the simplicity of the piano melody is light and touching, with a feeling of pensive restraint. It is beautiful accompaniment to the close of a drama, or of a midday reverie. Composed by Erik Satie.

tracks.title: Gymnopedie No. 2
tracks.description: This piece is dramatic and very dynamic; in the beginning and towards the end the music is soft and tender, but it is punctuated by aggressive changes in volume and minor chords throughout. This piece could work well to depict grief, as the emotions and feelings are similarly mercurial. Composed by Erik Satie.

tracks.title: Gymnopedie No. 3
tracks.description: A slow waltz with a beautiful and haunting melody played mostly in the higher registers. A few notes were added to Satie?s composition to keep things interesting and give the music a more full sound, the music ends with a very dark chord. This music is sad and tragic, and could be used as accompaniment to a slow dance or an art house film. Composed by Erik Satie.

tracks.title: Gypsy Shoegazer
tracks.description: No, I don't know what this is. Some sort of Bulgarian dirge? It has a good 2-part folk melody that is pretty easy to sing, and a wonderful B section with super cadences at the middle and end.

tracks.title: Gypsy Shoegazer No Voices
tracks.description: No, I don't know what this is. Same as Gypsy Shoegazer, but without the vocal parts... in case you want to add you own vocal parts.

tracks.title: Habanera
tracks.instruments: Solo Female Voice, Clarinet, Strings, Brass, Percussion
tracks.description: The famous Habanera aria from Georges Bizet's opera "Carmen". Sung by Jenny Lee Mitchell.

tracks.title: Hackbeat
tracks.description: Only obliquely Latin, I didn't know how else to classify this one. No melody.

tracks.title: Half Mystery
tracks.description: They make you think, but not too much. When you have a character in your film that is doing something, but we aren't quite sure why, THIS is your track. Packing a suitcase full of marshmallows? Half Mystery! Wiring a toaster into the side of a city bus? Half Mystery! Talking to their mother-in-law about monocot sexuality? Actually... that might be too much for this track.

tracks.title: Hall of the Mountain King
tracks.description: Edvard Grieg's famous piece from Peer Gynt (1876). You know this piece.  Starts quiet - ends loud. This is a "cinematic mix" that is a little sharper than most recordings and less dynamic. Source recordings placed into the Public Domain by the MusOpen project.

tracks.title: Halls of the Undead
tracks.instruments: Pipe Organ, Percussion, Choir, Oboe, Tubas, Trombones, Chimes, French Horns
tracks.description: Deep dark background undercurrent.

tracks.title: Hammock Fight
tracks.description: Light background... possibly for a physical comedy bit.

tracks.title: Hamster March
tracks.instruments: Trumpets, Snare, Bass Clarinet, Trombones, Marimba
tracks.description: A snappy little tune that might have been found in the 50s.

tracks.title: Hand Balance Redux
tracks.description: Intense, slightly urban piece with rich chordal melodies.

tracks.title: Hand Trolley
tracks.description: Lively yet quiet barroom-style ditty.

tracks.title: Happy Alley
tracks.description: Very upbeat and peppy piece with an usual bridge, all driven by an acoustic guitar.

tracks.title: Happy Bee
tracks.description: Fun little organ based super light rock tune with some 1950's sensibilities.

tracks.title: Happy Bee - Surf
tracks.description: Sort of an early surf rock piece.

tracks.title: Happy Boy End Theme
tracks.description: Happy bouncy theme for a comic hero! Written for Craig Knitt's short "Happy Boy". This track has themes in 2 variations in 2 tempos.

tracks.title: Happy Boy Theme
tracks.description: Happy bouncy theme for a comic hero! Written for Craig Knitt's short "Happy Boy".

tracks.title: Happy Happy Game Show
tracks.description: Okay, it is a 12 bar blues, but you got to stick around at least until the horns! I couldn't start with the horns as that would be a frightening level of happy. The uncompressed download also comes with a perfectly loopable track for those who don't want the party to end.

tracks.title: Hard Boiled
tracks.description: You're looking for the low-down, huh? That's going to take lettuce.  You want the dope? the scoop? the skinny? Ten bucks a day plus expenses. No negotiations. I ain't no fourth-rate gumshoe - but a ducky shincracker like you already knew that... Out of curiosity, what's the word for people who overuse slang?

tracks.title: Harlequin
tracks.description: Quirky little duet. Major contrast between a staccato piano line, and the sweeping long bass clarinet.

tracks.title: Harmful or Fatal
tracks.description: Electronica (techo, light industrial). This one moves with a crazy speed guitar doubling some synth lines, and making some lines or its own. Harsh.

tracks.title: Healing
tracks.description: Mostly pentatonic piece. Listening may cause healing of undisclosed issues.

tracks.title: Heart of Nowhere
tracks.description: Lush vocals and calming chords.

tracks.title: Heart of the Beast
tracks.description: Alien soundscape with touches of humanity. Low and smooth; discordant.

tracks.title: Heartbreaking
tracks.description: Disappointment from hope.

tracks.title: Heartwarming
tracks.description: Quick and flowing like water, the piano is warm and bright, perfect for a romantic comedy or tender interlude. The melody is sweet and repeated four times in different refrains. First at the main register, then an octave lower at 0:12. After the bridge interlude at 0:23, the melody resumes at 0:35, and at 0:49 plays in a higher register, then slows to the final arpeggiated resolve.

tracks.title: Heavy Heart
tracks.description: We've all been there. It is a little sad, a little hopeful... like when you finally set your rescue owl back into the world. You're sad to see her go, but you hope for the best. You've done all you can inside... her wings work pretty well now, and she can snatch the mice from your living room floor even when you put in a bunch of fake plants in the way to give the prey cover. Nothing to do now but hope Blossom can rule the night as you hoped she one day would. Also... time to buy a bunch of mousetraps.

tracks.title: Heavy Interlude
tracks.instruments: Bouzouki, Hammer Dulcimer, Violin, Basses, Cellos, Violas, Percussion.
tracks.description: A short, bouncy, medieval sounding piece with heavy use of Bouzouki and Hammer Dulcimer.  Strings used in the background, main melody carried by Violin and Hammer Dulcimer.

tracks.title: Hep Cats
tracks.instruments: Organ, Bass, Percussion, Flute, Electric Piano, Guitar
tracks.description: Going to the grocery store? Need a theme for that? Maybe you've got a swank cocktail party that needs some swank music? All of these things are possible and more with this upbeat organ-based piece!

tracks.title: Hero Down
tracks.instruments: Strings, French Horn, Trombones, Percussion, Flute
tracks.description:
A piece in three or four parts... depending on how you count parts. The penultimate section features a lonely flute, slowly joined by a children's choir, and finally exploding into a giant choral and orchestral ending.

 From the original soundtrack to "The Last Stand of the Mechanolith".

tracks.title: Hero Theme
tracks.description: A short, powerful theme with a bit of hope.

tracks.title: Heroic Age
tracks.instruments: Flutes, Clarinets, Oboes, Trombones, Tuba, Cellos, Basses, Percussion, Celesta
tracks.description: See title, instrumentation, tempo, and feels for description. Originally written for a live performance.

tracks.title: Heroic Reception
tracks.description: Piano fanfare.

tracks.title: Hidden Agenda
tracks.instruments: Cellos, Violas, Bassoon, Xylophone, Glock, Oboe, Percussion
tracks.description: Intimate sneaking around sort of music. Many breaks and hits allow for re-editing to suit the scene.

tracks.title: Hidden Past
tracks.description: Pipes, pipes, and more pipes! Irish? Scottish? Celtic? I have no idea. But sure - could be any of those. Let's call it "Ancient British Isles".

tracks.title: Hidden Wonders
tracks.description: Would you like to sample my wares? I specialize in non-djinn-infested housewares! Djinn-free spoons, Djinn-free curtains, Djinn-free spices, mostly Djinn-free oil lamps, Djinn-free flying carpets (still magic, but not Djinn powered). Come on in to Gazeem's Discount mostly-Djinn-free Housewares Tent! You won't be disappointed... unless you want a Djinn, then go see Maghrib.

tracks.title: Hiding Your Reality
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Synths, Brass, Tuba, Euphonium, Bass Trombone, Trombone, French Horn, Trumpet
tracks.description: It hurts my brain to switch from english words to symbols. Try to read these words and symbols out loud quickly: hyphen-slash-backslash/dash/-\hyphen//hashtag_octothorpe#- Crazy, right? That had nothing to do with this piece of music. I'm just sharing.

tracks.title: Highlight Reel
tracks.instruments: Kit, Bass, Electric Guitar, Saxes, Trumpet
tracks.description: Not pure rock, it has jazz and funk characteristics. Reminds me of the under music for a sports highlights telecast. Rock beat, a few guitars, and a nice electric bass.

tracks.title: Himalayan Atmosphere
tracks.description: A Tibetan atmospheric that is a mix of rhythmic and arhythmic sounds.

tracks.title: Hit the Streets
tracks.description: Scoring essentials. You know that one piece of music that you hear when you follow your character out onto the street, and watch them do... something around the neighborhood. That's this. v2 is the same as this but faster.

tracks.title: Hit the Streets v2
tracks.description: Scoring essentials. You know that one piece of music that you hear when you follow your character out onto the street, and watch them do... something around the neighborhood. That's this. This is the faster version.

tracks.title: Hitman
tracks.description: Extension of a piece I wrote for Bite Sized Minecraft 2. Super-produced. Super awesome.

tracks.title: Holiday Weasel
tracks.instruments: Cello, Bassoon, Xylophone, Flutes, Clarinets, Percussion
tracks.description: Rhythms are not copyrightable. Don't even start!

tracks.title: Home Base Groove
tracks.description: Short loopable piece meant for a video game section.

tracks.title: Honey Bee
tracks.description: The electric piano alternates between playing the rhythm and creating a sliding melody, while trumpets sound in the background, sometimes stealing the melody. The percussion makes for a toe-tapping good time. This is useful for the closing segment of a TV show, game, or transition. Cleanly loopable.

tracks.title: Hot Pursuit
tracks.description: RUN! It is the Hemiola Monster!!!! We just need to get to the bar! It doesn't seem to want to cross the bar! Oh my GOD! It has friends!! No wait, that's just a standard clave pattern...  (no, I'm not explaining this description OR what is wrong with my head.)

tracks.title: Hot Swing
tracks.instruments: Bass, Saxes, Piano, Kit, Clarinet, Trombone, Trumpet
tracks.description: A nice upbeat swing tune with a change-up in the middle, and big ending.

tracks.title: Hotrock
tracks.instruments: Kit, Bass, Electric Guitar, Bari Sax, Tenor Sax, Trumpet
tracks.description: Power guitar rock with a 4-piece horn section.

tracks.title: How it Begins
tracks.description: Rounded quantized synths with a happy happy backbeat. This is quite happy.

tracks.title: Hush
tracks.description: Creepy little piece with a buildup and action hit around 1:30.

tracks.title: Hustle
tracks.description: The bass guitar plays a familiar rolling Blues riff, while accompanied by organ, acoustic guitar, and drums. A toe-tapping beat plays throughout, and can be used as the background music for a fast-paced game or scene, or as the intro to a scene full of bustling people.

tracks.title: Hyperfun
tracks.description: Some ragtime, some western saloon piano, all fun. More fun than you can handle. That's HYPERfun!

tracks.title: Hypnothis
tracks.description: Sweet chill electronic piece with a run of dissonances starting around 3 minutes in.

tracks.title: I Can Feel it Coming
tracks.description: Just your average, run-of-the-mill tension filler music... Or IS it!? Yeah, it pretty much is. This does feature a poorly played guitar synth, though... so it is a stand-out in that way. If you were here for tension-building music, you already have this piece... Move along.

tracks.title: I Feel You
tracks.description: A sort of backgroundy 1980's-ish dreamy rock fusion thingee.

tracks.title: I Got a Stick Arr Bryan Teoh
tracks.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drums, Trumpets, Saxophones, Trombone, Triangle, Voice
tracks.description: Funky Horns? Funk!  Funky Guitar? Funk!  Funky Bass? Funk!  Funky Drumming? Double Funk!!  Arrangement and instruments: Bryan Teoh

tracks.title: I Got a Stick Feat James Gavins
tracks.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drums, Trumpets, Saxophones, Trombone, Triangle, Voice
tracks.description: Funky Horns? Funk!  Funky Guitar? Funk!  Funky Bass? Funk!  Funky Drumming? Double Funk!!  Vocals: James Gavins. Uncopyrightable Lyrics: ("I got a stick.") James Gavins and Kevin MacLeod Arrangement and instruments: Bryan Teoh

tracks.title: I Knew a Guy
tracks.description: Slow walking bass, drums follow along sparely, with a cool Vibe melody.

tracks.title: Ibn Al-Noor
tracks.description: Evocative of the Arab world, the music begins stoically; the melody accentuated by simple percussive sounds. Within the first minute, the strings hypnotize with their sinuous melody, the tribal drumming awakening the senses. In the third minute the piece changes to a heavy, dangerous string and tribal drumming that builds until all of the instruments come together in a fitful way, until the abrupt ending.

tracks.title: Ice Demon
tracks.description: Hollow creepy background pad. This is not the feel-good hit of the summer. It is more like the cheese-grater to the brain of uncomfortableness.

tracks.title: Ice Flow
tracks.description: This is another piece where the Feel descriptors don't work all that well. This is a sort of urban chill mix.

tracks.title: Ignosi
tracks.instruments: Trombones, Basses, Flutes, Clarinet, Marimba, Percussion, Horn, Violins, Violas
tracks.description: Starts without percussion, then adds in a groove later on.

tracks.title: Immersed
tracks.description: Minimal and somewhat droney in parts, this has a beautiful calmness about it. You can use it to sell anti-depressants or high performance automobile parts. Also useful for time-lapse photography of the night sky... or maybe a rocket launch.

tracks.title: Impact Allegretto
tracks.description: Track 5 of 6. Percussion starts on the offbeat. Large shift at 34 seconds, building to another at 42 seconds. Additional shift to mostly percussion at 1:52. Good pacing contours.

tracks.title: Impact Andante
tracks.description: 2 of 6. This piece changes perspectives a few times, and stays very fresh throughout.

tracks.title: Impact Intermezzo
tracks.description: 4 of 6. Zero melody, all percussion piece... might be useful for anything that needs a bit of urgency, but not too much.

tracks.title: Impact Lento
tracks.description: 6 of 6. Very slow start. This piece uses warm but thin textures, and several striking chord progressions.

tracks.title: Impact Moderato
tracks.description: 3 of 6. Laid back drum kit with a lot of extra percussion under a simple guitar.

tracks.title: Impact Prelude
tracks.description: 1 of 6. Chill opening theme with lots of percussion bits.

tracks.title: Impending Boom
tracks.description: That sort of tension music for when people are trying to diffuse a bomb. Has other uses as well. Sixteenth notes beginning to end.

tracks.title: Impromptu in Blue
tracks.description: Impromptu performed on a Steinway Model D tuned to Quarter Comma Meantone. In this piece the most out-of-tune notes give it a feel that is not often heard in contemporary piano music.

tracks.title: Impromptu in Quarter Comma Meantone
tracks.description: Impromptu performed on a Steinway Model D tuned to Quarter Comma Meantone. This gives a very rich feel to the base chords, but leaves a couple of "wolf notes" in the gaps (most notably in the Ab). 2 minutes in, it lingers on the most out-of tune part of the scales.

tracks.title: In a Heartbeat
tracks.feel: Aggressive, Unnerving, Action, Driving, Dark, Intense
tracks.description: Electronica (industrial dance). Hard, hard, super-hard, gritty, you-had--better-want-to-be-angry electronica. This piece is fast and harsh.

tracks.title: In The West
tracks.description: The percussion and strings start off bright, but deceive you as they turn to a powerful minor key. The string bass plays a prominent role, interacting with and leading the treble to the sudden conclusion.

tracks.title: In Your Arms
tracks.description: A piece of music from a more elegant time, 1940. This is a beautiful slow piece that will make you want to pick up some champagne and go off slow dancing with people... or penguins. I like penguins. And now some searchable words: Big Band. 1940s. Forties. Formal Party. Penguin Slow Dance. No Whammies.

tracks.title: Industrial Cinematic
tracks.description: The Year: Future Year. The planet has been ravaged by desertification... that apparently no one saw coming... Not sure how that happened, I mean Jeez! Anyone ever hear of a little disaster called "The Aral Sea"? That seriously screwed up... like... everything. I guess the dam is supposed to help, but I'm seriously not holding my breath. Oh. Industrial-sounding music.

tracks.title: Industrial Music Box
tracks.description: Music box with 2 ranks of tines, and one set of bells.

tracks.title: Industrial Revolution
tracks.instruments: Cello, Pipe Organ, Trombones, Horns, Trumpets, Tubas, Percussion
tracks.description: A sort of steampunk industrial piece with a lovely melody.

tracks.title: Industrious Ferret
tracks.instruments: Lute, English Horn, Cellos, Violas, Percussion
tracks.description: How bustling do Gnomish villages get? I imagine not more bustling than this.  If I were a gnome.... out there bustling my butt every day, this would be my soundtrack.

tracks.title: Inexorable
tracks.description: Highly processed and oddly played piano makes up the harmonic base of this piece. Sort sort of ticking clock thing... This is a brash mix, but probably not as bad as you think!

tracks.title: Infados
tracks.description: Thins out at 1:30, then adds in and accelerates, dropping back down for another build. Abrupt ending.

tracks.title: Infinite Perspective
tracks.instruments: Synths, Voices, Piano, Harp, English Horn, French Horn, Flute
tracks.description: All the beauty, awe and calm majesty you can handle... without a permit or prescription medication. The download comes with a faster and slower bonus tempo as well as the original sketch on marimba that was used in making this piece!

tracks.title: Inner Light
tracks.description: A chill, reverb-drenched romantic piece in 6/8

tracks.title: Inner Sanctum
tracks.description: Glimmering darkness with some smooth emergences and some sharp. Spectrally, this is all over the place. It creeps me out.

tracks.title: Inspired
tracks.description: Quite a broad piece. Could be used for corporate films of intricate industrial processes, or a flashback scene to the time at the lake a few summers ago. Maybe good background to your cousin's magic show at the last family reunion. Or a film where you do "industrial processes" at the "lake" with your "cousin". It is really quite versatile!

tracks.title: Interloper
tracks.feel: Action, Dark, Eerie, Epic, Intense, Mysterious, Suspenseful, Unnerving
tracks.description: Multi-part cue that builds as it accelerates.

tracks.title: Intractable
tracks.description: Probably best classified as light-funk. Chorused bass line.

tracks.title: Intrepid
tracks.instruments: Basses, Cellos, Tuba, Trombones, Prepared Piano, Voice, Drums
tracks.description: This has a little bit of early music flair to it with a nice vocal performance (if you don't like the vocals, you can get a version without in the super download). I've listened to this piece non-stop for like an hour. Still beautiful! The least you could do is listen to this once! It is only a few minutes. Go ahead!

tracks.title: Intuit
tracks.description: I chose the sound palate, and then assembled the piece without listening to it. The interesting bit is that it was assembled visually - looking at the waveform profiles. This is my first one, and the sound selections are all amiable. I am unsure of the genre. Trance?

tracks.title: Invariance
tracks.description: One file that contains the same piece in 2 tempos; slower and faster. The slower version gives a more tribal feel - the fast one destroys that, and lends a slight edge-of-the-seat feel.

tracks.title: Investigations
tracks.instruments: Pizzicato strings, english horn, bassoon, marimba, glock, cowbells
tracks.description: Sort of a loafing comedic piece for all of your amusing scenes with dialog that does not need to move the story. Also reasonable for scenes with no dialog.

tracks.title: Iron Bacon
tracks.description: Mid-tempo rockin' tune from the fictional band Glory Nugget. Can they play? Absolutely not. It is awesome? Absolutely.

tracks.title: Iron Horse
tracks.description: Darkly plodding, this staccato piano piece is the tense setting for the classic silent film scene: the heroine is tied to the train tracks, the steam engine train plugging along towards her. The chug-a-chug feel is maintained by a tense hammering of the chords in triplets, depicting machinery or chaos set in motion without an end in sight.

tracks.title: Iron Horse - Distressed
tracks.description: Darkly plodding, this staccato piano piece is the tense setting for the classic silent film scene: the heroine is tied to the train tracks, the steam engine train plugging along towards her. The chug-a-chug feel is maintained by a tense hammering of the chords in triplets, depicting machinery or chaos set in motion without an end in sight.

tracks.title: Ishikari Lore
tracks.description: A new piece derived from Eastern folk music.

tracks.title: Island Meet and Greet
tracks.instruments: Steel Drum, Marimba, Ukulele, Bass, Percussion
tracks.description: While this is a party, we caution all the lemmings out there against the formation of conga lines. Things can, and have, taken a turn for the tragic out by the cliffs, volcanos, quicksand pits, coconut groves, tidal pools, and most tragic of all… the gift shop.

tracks.title: Isolated
tracks.description: Intricate finger styling on a bass guitar creates a thematic melody full of solitude that drastically slows to a lethargic ending. This makes for a great transition piece for an outdoors scene or to depict isolation.

tracks.title: It Came Upon a Midnight Clear
tracks.description: You know that touching Christmas slideshow you're working on? This is for that.

tracks.title: It is Lost
tracks.description: Highly melodic pad with a sense of fleeting hope.

tracks.title: Itty Bitty 8 Bit
tracks.description: Playful and interesting, Itty Bitty 8-Bit immediately introduces you to a pulsating melody flitting above a synthesized bass. The melody changes in the second minute and builds while climbing the chromatic scale, before settling back into the familiar refrain. This could be looped for a classic-styled videogame that is quirky and imaginative.

tracks.title: Jalandhar
tracks.description: Super groovy Indian-inspired piece with a chill bass line, and amazing percussion.

tracks.title: Jaunty Gumption
tracks.description: Mid-90s styled happy happy video game music.

tracks.title: Jazz Brunch
tracks.description: This is the music playing at the slightly-too-nice cafe - while you pretend to be rational while discussing who gets to keep which snakes in the divorce. I mean, the snakes don't really seem to care... they just hang out in the drawers most of the time. And you kind of really want to keep Alice, the piebald ball python... she's really photogenic, but she is kind of a jerk.

tracks.title: Jellyfish in Space
tracks.instruments: Guitar, Ocarina, EP, Bass, Synths, Percussion
tracks.description: This is somewhat relaxing, while still having some forward momentum. Kind of like sleeping on a train... or taking MBA classes. I like the spinney-sounding synths. The chorus effects give this piece a watery feel. Kind of like a shimmering pond... or being on hold for an insurance company run by sperm whales.

tracks.title: Jerry Five
tracks.description: Sort of a cooler, driving piece. Lots of space in this piece to make it your own. I don't mean "make it your own" in that sort of way you do where you mark all the pancakes on your plate with your signature so you can tell if someone switched out your pancakes while you weren't looking. Honestly that's pretty weird.Who could possibly want to switch out your pancakes? I mean - who thinks like that? Sure, everyone NOW wants to screw with your pancakes, but before you started all of this - it wouldn't have crossed one person's mind! NOT ONE!

tracks.title: Jesu, Joy of Man's Desiring
tracks.description: This is a truncated version of BWV 147. J. S. Bach.

tracks.title: Jet Fueled Vixen
tracks.description: Griggs! I've been poisoned! You gotta get me the antidote! Then you gotta get... like a crane, or something to lift this truck off me! She dropped a truck on me, Griggs!!! Then, if you could find me a decent deal on high speed internet - that would be great! The plans are all too confusing, and I do NOT WANT CABLE TV OR TELEPHONES! Can you believe anyone still has telephones, Griggs? Griggs??!!?

tracks.title: Jingle Bells
tracks.description: Loud manic sing-along-but-don't-take-a-breath version recorded for a stage production.

tracks.title: Jingle Bells
tracks.description: Happy, clappy arrangement worthy of a 6th grade band program.

tracks.title: Jingle Bells (Calm)
tracks.description: Quite a calm arrangement of a piece that should probably be more joyous. Slow and free. This isn't really a sing-along type recording.

tracks.title: Joey's Formal Waltz - Scented
tracks.instruments: Electric Piano, Guitar, Bass, Kit, Farts
tracks.description: It's your Grade 10 Formal and no one is dancing. All the usual cliques are in all the usual places, and questions are spinning around in your head... Would Alex actually dance with me? How can I make that happen? What's that smell? Did I wear deodorant? What exactly do I do with my left hand!? How big IS the Holy Ghost!???  It is my sincerest wish that this piece be requested at every high-school aged formal dance, for obvious reasons.  Also available in unscented.

tracks.title: Joey's Formal Waltz - Unscented
tracks.description: There are NO FARTS in this version. If you're looking for farts, you want the "Scented" version.  Just your average, repeated, beautiful slow waltz with some chill EP and electric guitar.  Also available with fart sounds.

tracks.title: Journey To Ascend
tracks.description: Jamming on some cheap percussion with some friends and a click track.  Recommended uses for this track: Tiki bar, Museum exhibit of a bear,  On hold music for an adventure bike tour company, Street festival in Monrovia (Liberia - not California).

tracks.title: Juniper
tracks.description: Themes, rhythms, chords all stolen from Holst.

tracks.title: Junkyard Tribe
tracks.description: Accelerating piece of contemporary electronic percussions. There's some bit crusting going down, and a few other things. No melodies - just the hits.

tracks.title: Just As Soon
tracks.instruments: Bass, Acoustic Guitar, Brushed Kit, EP, Tenor Sax
tracks.description: Slow 6/8. Did you ever get up in the middle of the night and wonder what would happen if you took a Spanish guitar player, tell them to do a ballad, and give them a tasteful jazz quartet? I did.

tracks.title: Just Nasty
tracks.instruments: EP, Kit, Organ, Trumpet, Trombone, Tenor Sax, Bari Sax
tracks.description: A driving funk piece that is sometimes distorted because it plays with clashing grooves. EP prominent throughout the entire piece. Kit mainly in the background. Horn section accompanies EP in several places, however is not used equally throughout.

tracks.title: Kalimba Relaxation Music
tracks.description: Can you believe kalimbas are only like $20? Check them out in my amazon affilliate store! (I do not have an amazon affiliate store.)

tracks.title: Kawai Kitsune
tracks.description: A very electronic semi-soothing piece of bleeps and bloops! I originally wrote this piece to be calm, but in the uncompressed download, there are a couple of faster versions! YOU CANNOT CONTAIN THE EXCITEMENT!

tracks.title: Keystone Deluge
tracks.description: This piece has 3 major sections, all of which are large and violent.

tracks.title: Kick Shock
tracks.instruments: Synth Keys, Synth Drums, Triangle, Electronics
tracks.description: Poppy electronic dance piece, thick with synths and phasing.  Strong lead synth melody in beginning, ends with exposed drum part.

tracks.title: Killers
tracks.instruments: Guitar, Choir, Percussion, Basses, Cellos, Violas, Violins
tracks.description: This piece starts BIG. Originally, this piece started slowly and built... and then I got bored and chopped out all the slowness. There are still dynamics, but if you need bigness from the get-go - here's what you get! Vroom! BIG BIG BIG! Could be too big. Could be. Probably isn't.

tracks.title: Killing Time
tracks.description: Super bright super tight electronic mix with a beat turn-around around 2 minutes in, followed by swirling synths.

tracks.title: Kings of Tara
tracks.instruments: Bass, Drums, Kit, Guitar, Flute, Banjo
tracks.description: This one is just cool. If you just tried to dance to this and fell over, that's because every measure is missing one beat. Still it grooves quite well, assuming you can groove in 7/4 time. Uncompressed download comes with individual tracks so you can make your own mixes.

tracks.title: Klockworx
tracks.description: This piece is in a genre sort of made by an electronic instrument from Yamaha called the Tenori-On (though it was not made on one of them). It is a sixteenth note-quantized all-synth 4 bar repeated thing. Items are only added, never removed.

tracks.title: Kool Kats
tracks.description: A sort of simple lounge chill spy piece.

tracks.title: Krampus Workshop
tracks.instruments: Cello, Bassoons, Trumpet, Xylophone, French Horns, Flute, Glockenspiel, Tuba, Trombones, Percussion, Chimes
tracks.description: Is it looking a little claymation in here, or is it just me?

tracks.title: Kumasi Groove
tracks.description: Small drum ensemble based loosely on west African styles. This one is pretty laid back. Tumba/Conga/Quinto/Marimba/Shakers/etc.

tracks.title: Kumasi Groove (plus flugelhorn)
tracks.description: Small drum ensemble based loosely on west African styles. This version also features a be-bop flugelhorn solo. Tumba/Conga/Quinto/Marimba/Shakers/etc.

tracks.title: Lachaim
tracks.instruments: Kit, Bass, Guitar, Clarinet, Trombone, Sax, Violin
tracks.description: Klezmer band arrangement.

tracks.title: Laconic Granny
tracks.description: Lumbering tuba-driven tune with heavy back beat appropriate for character underscore. Ends Abruptly.

tracks.title: Lagoa v1
tracks.description: Brazilian carnival style samba music. This is the most chill of the pieces I've made in this style.

tracks.title: Lagoa v2
tracks.description: Brazilian carnival style music at an aggressive tempo. It is not possible to be unhappy listening to this.

tracks.title: Laid Back Guitars
tracks.description: An experiment in reverb. The piece itself has two Spanish guitars with lots of different percussion backings. The congas are definitely reverb-affected more noticeably than the bells or cymbals.

tracks.title: Lamentation
tracks.description: Slow solo harp piece.

tracks.title: Land of Phantoms
tracks.description: More a creepy orchestral percussive soundscape than a piece of music with melody and harmony. That thing you can't identify is a gong being played abnormally.

tracks.title: Land of the Dead
tracks.description: A background pad full of human souls. A cacophony of choirs run in counter directions. This is very unpleasant to listen to at volume.

tracks.title: Laser Groove
tracks.description: It came from the 1980s, but was mutated by some trap monster which gave it a new lease on life! I'm not gonna lie, this is an odd hybrid - super useful for your YouTube channels! You can't not like this piece... unless you have no soul.

tracks.title: Laserpack
tracks.description: Hey, man! Is that an Atoke? Hells yeah, its an Atoke! If I could choose of any shape of percussion - I’m going to choose "Taco-shaped percussion". There is no other feeling quite like beating your metal taco with a stick. I wish this description were more fictional than it actually is.

tracks.title: Last Kiss Goodnight
tracks.description: Classic 50's/60's I, iv, IV, V chord progression as in "Unchained Melody" or "Sleepwalk".

tracks.title: Lasting Hope
tracks.feel: Dark, Eerie, Mystical, Relaxed, Intense, Somber
tracks.description: Minimal percussion gives a subtle edge to the smooth synth line.

tracks.title: Late Night Radio
tracks.description: You know when you're at a friend's house overnight for an experimental airplane convention and there are people sleeping on various sofas, so you don't want to turn on the lights - but then you run your shin smack into the metal coffee table, knocking over 3 mostly empty bottles and somehow breaking your friends glasses? This music is the nice feeling before the coffee table incident.

tracks.title: Latin Industries
tracks.description: Halting electronic dance piece that ends with a giant lush finale.

tracks.title: Le Grand Chase
tracks.instruments: Piano, Percussion, Xylophone, Bari Sax, Tuba, Trumpet, Car Horns
tracks.description: You never notice how effective a car horn is until you use it. I usually park my car near a sidewalk and alarm 7 year olds on their way to and from school. 7 year olds are your target market for this sort of thing. They jump like antelope! All the kids in my neighborhood are acclimatized, now. It isn't as much fun. You also never notice how effective a Picardy third is until you do it with car horns. You're welcome.

tracks.title: Leaving Home
tracks.instruments: Synths, Guitar, Flute, Clarinet, Zither, Piano
tracks.description: Ukulele and flutes and glockenspiel... I think you already know what this sounds like. The percussion is also adorable.

tracks.title: Leblon
tracks.description: Mid-up-tempo Brazilian carnival style piece. ABA form.

tracks.title: Legend of One
tracks.description: Dark electronic piece with piano carrying the interest.

tracks.title: Leopard Print Elevator
tracks.description: Smooth. Seriously smooth. Smooth like you can't even imagine how smooth this is. Still has a lot of life, though! The uncompressed download comes with an alternate mix with a super deep electric bass for even more smoothness! Did I mention it is smooth? Sort of like an early 1970's era vibe to it. But smoother.

tracks.title: Level Up
tracks.description: Too cool for school! This is a warm and refreshing, yet invigorating piece of 8-bit-like wonderfulness. Lots of modern blipping and bleeping once it gets going. I imagine this piece can be used in a lot of computer games about computer games. There's also a bunch of overdrive on "Level Up". Loops perfectly for all you video game devs out there!

tracks.title: Lewis and Dekalb
tracks.description: Southern trap influenced rap pile of musical forklift platypus... okay, I don't know what these words mean. But if you understood them - we're all good. You know what you're getting, and... that's all I can hope for really. Truth in advertising!

tracks.title: Life of Riley
tracks.description: Mid-tempo cheery music for all!

tracks.title: Lift Motif
tracks.description: Airy-sounding short waltz.

tracks.title: Light Awash
tracks.description: VERY LARGE FILE. This is a 30 minute atmospheric piece done entirely with slow attack synths.

tracks.title: Light Sting
tracks.description: Ascending melody.

tracks.title: Light Thought var 1
tracks.description: This is the slower of a pair of pieces. Useful for non-obtrusive backgrounds to ads or film sequences with voice-overs. No surprises.

tracks.title: Light Thought var 2
tracks.description: This is the faster of a pair of pieces. Useful for non-obtrusive backgrounds to ads or film sequences with voice-overs. No surprises.

tracks.title: Lightless Dawn
tracks.feel: Dark, Eerie, Mysterious, Mystical, Somber, Unnerving
tracks.description: Add a dark intensity to any scene... Is there building action? Is there a clue? Is there a need for ambiguity?

tracks.title: Limit 70
tracks.description: You know those lines on the highways? If you go exactly 70 miles per hour in the US, the lines will match up perfectly with this piece. I did the math. The actual tempo of this piece is 102.65 beats per minute.

tracks.title: Lithium
tracks.description: Okay, it SAYS piano, pipe organ, and violins - but it doesn't sound like that. And it SAYS somber, but it isn't really. What this is - is a Really powerful piece.

tracks.title: Lively Lumpsucker
tracks.description: Hijinks, antics, shenanigan, tomfoolery! We got it all here for you! Solo out of tune piano for all of your slapstick needs! Sheet music available (More button).

tracks.title: Living Voyage
tracks.description: Earthy and yet urban with a mix of personal and epic. This is a hybrid in all senses. Major uplift at 40 seconds in. Drops back down for another feel at 1:10.

tracks.title: Lobby Time
tracks.description: Welcome to the lobby of the FUTURE! Luxurious automatic ashtrays, and modern green vinyl furnishings set off the shag carpeted walls. Enjoy a Rusty Nail from our cheerful bar staff (with a complimentary cheese and fruit plate before 5pm). We feature prime rib dinners every day that ends in a "y"! Remember to tip the bellhops at least 5 cents per bag. Enjoy your stay! This was written 2 years before it was published, because I didn't have a good enough upright bass sample to make it go.

tracks.title: Local Forecast
tracks.instruments: Piano, Bass, Kit, EP, Flute, Trumpet, Percussion, Guitar
tracks.description:
Spritely little jazz hybrid piece.This tempo has about the most drive possible for this piece. Available in 2 other versions (slower, and elevator). This version cleanly loops.
https://musescore.com/user/33869100/scores/15437857

tracks.title: Local Forecast - Elevator
tracks.instruments: Piano, Bass, Kit, EP, Flute, Trumpet, Percussion, Guitar
tracks.description: This tempo has a very should-be-in-a-lift vibe. So I processed it and mixed it to sound like crappy elevator speakers. Why not go all the way?  Available in 2 other versions (original, and slower).

tracks.title: Local Forecast - Slower
tracks.instruments: Piano, Bass, Kit, EP, Flute, Trumpet, Percussion, Guitar
tracks.description: Super laid-back chillin jazz hybrid piece. It has a sort of a tiki, spacey vibe. Available in 2 other versions (original, and elevator). This version cleanly loops.

tracks.title: Lone Harvest
tracks.instruments: Piano, Harp, Violin, Basses, Clarinet, Flute
tracks.description: It looks like an uncommon mix of descriptive words, but this simple piece does a good job of displaying complex emotion.

tracks.title: Long Note Four
tracks.instruments: Piano, Choir, Violins, Basses, Percussion, Synths
tracks.description: A fairly intense beginning with a small piano part I pulled from a thing I wrote last week (Trio for Piano Violin and Viola), followed by a very long section of not moving much.

tracks.title: Long note One
tracks.description: Just a very long pad for use under dialog.

tracks.title: Long Note Three
tracks.description: A very long dark note. Use under dialog, or to kill site noise.

tracks.title: Long Note Two
tracks.description: Heavy effects on an arhythmic piano, and very deep bass.

tracks.title: Long Road Ahead
tracks.description: Very simple folk melody. Like the aftermath of a battle between good and evil. Major triumphant section for the final third of the piece.

tracks.title: Long Road Ahead B
tracks.description: Same as "Long Road Ahead", but without the final triumphant section.

tracks.title: Long Stroll
tracks.description: Not sure what this is... Reminds me of a 1940's film... maybe a musical? Jazz combo with Fluglehorn, EP improv in the middle.

tracks.title: Long Time Coming
tracks.description: Tense and mercurial, ?Long Time Coming? begins with a slow, frenetic crescendo, and at 0:40 builds into the main melody with heavy percussion. At 1:04 the percussion is tacit, and at 1:18 a rippling crescendo builds to long, demented pulls on the string bass. The percussive beat begins again at 2:18, and then the frenzied, reverbed staccato of the piano enters, accompanied by a swelling synth lead. At 3:40 the piece finds it?s stride with pulsating synthesizer effects and a rumbling bass line. Best used as accompaniment for a tense, difficult level of a game or as the final battle with a villain. Because of its steady bass beat and snyth effects, this could also work well to depict a tense and suspenseful race to the finish, or as the music playing during a vibrant, pounding rave.

tracks.title: Longing and Concern
tracks.instruments: French Horns, Trombones, Flute, Woodblock, Trumpet, Strings
tracks.description: This is a great calm piece, featuring horns in the beginning, moving to flute.  Piece ends with a short fanfare with the trumpet and strings.  Fanfare begins at 1:03.

tracks.title: Look Busy
tracks.instruments: Piano, Bass, Kit, Clarinet, Tuba, Trumpet
tracks.description: Almost New Orleans-style; almost march. This is the faster embellished version of the piano solo "Breaktime" (found elsewhere on this site).

tracks.title: Loopster
tracks.description: One of the first hipster art forms, this is built by stacking simple phrases, and can be performed by one person. This makes it perfect for playing that Tuesday gig you managed to pull at Arlene’s Grocery. Sorry, man - I don't have any cloves. This is my last one.

tracks.title: Loping Sting
tracks.description: Just a quick little fun hit.

tracks.title: Lord of the Land
tracks.description: Middle of the road sort of medieval music... Also good when not travelling on a road.

tracks.title: Lord of the Rangs
tracks.description: It's all about Australia! Bop along with this cheery piece from down under. It was designed for the Australian-themed level of a tower defense game. There are a lot of boomerangs flying around when you upgrade your towers to level 3.

tracks.title: Loss
tracks.description: Dirge. Very slow, quiet, depressing. Occasionally punctuated with ornaments.

tracks.title: Lost Frontier
tracks.instruments: Violins, Cellos, Basses, Choir, French Horn, Percussion
tracks.description: Flautando (flute-tone) violins provide a bed for this slow-moving piece.

tracks.title: Lost Time
tracks.description: Is someone dying onscreen, but you still need some dialog so you can't go up against a solo oboe (the universal musical shorthand for death scenes)? We got this! Dark and moving, this piece will make you cry and not get in the way of those final bits of dialog! Also useful for sullen montage sequences of clergy activities.

tracks.title: Lotus
tracks.description: A pan-world percussion track. No melodies. Could be Australian, could be Indian, could be African, could be Chinese, could be Hawaiian. Probably Guamish.

tracks.title: Love Song
tracks.instruments: Orchestral - Flute, Alto Flute, Bass Flute, Piano, Harp, Horn
tracks.description: Plaintive and hopeful. Originally written for a musical, this piece got cut.

tracks.title: Luminous Rain
tracks.description: An excellent impromptu in G Major. Interesting choices throughout.

tracks.title: Maccary Bay
tracks.description: Modern sort of reggae with a lots of layers! Features the wah-riffic guitar work of Mr. Brett VanDonsel.

tracks.title: Machinations
tracks.instruments: Snare, Bass Drum, Tuba, Trombones, Bassoon, English Horn, Oboe, Strings
tracks.description: A driving piece with heavy usage of the tuba in the background providing a constant beat throughout the piece.  English Horns and Oboe's have small role in the middle of the piece.  Strings used throughout.

tracks.title: Magic Escape Room
tracks.instruments: Harp, Bassoon, Flutes, Celesta, Percussion, Oboe, Timpani, Cellos, Basses, Xylophone, Glockenspiel, Violins, Violas, French Horns, Trombones, Tuba, Pipe Organ, Clock Tower, Chimes, Church Bell
tracks.description: This pieces builds tension and speed all the time. The ramp-up starts slowly, and gets pretty crazy by the end. Like you're solving puzzles in a... Magical Escape Room! There are several natural break-points for easy editing. If you look at the instrument list, you can see where this piece is going.

tracks.title: Magic Forest
tracks.description: Remember that time you were lost in the woods and you were visited by the clan of  centaurs, and they were super suspicious of you, but decided to take you back to their settlement anyway? It never happened! That was a screen memory! There are no centaurs, and they wouldn't live in forest settlements! That was an alien abduction. The aliens planted the memory of the forest centaurs so your brain wouldn't implode with the knowledge of trans-dimensional beings... such as themselves. And... unrelated, but... what comes to mind when you think about the smell of wet cardboard and Sriracha?

tracks.title: Magistar
tracks.instruments: Choir, Glockenspiel, Trumpets, Trombones, Tubas, Percussion
tracks.description: The portal to my wizarding school is at the back of a payday loan place in Windsor, Ontario. It isn't quite as cool as that magic train station, but the loan place is open late. There is also a Tim Hortons across the street. So that's nice.

tracks.title: Majestic Hills
tracks.description: Several feel, tempo, and instrumentation changes throughout this orchestral piece.

tracks.title: Malicious
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Basses, Cellos, Violins, Flutes, Clarinets
tracks.description: More action and more intensity! Remember "Legends of the Hidden Temple"? Seriously? It only lasted 3 seasons. It must have been more difficult than it looked. Okay, I wasn't on the show, but I think I could have assembled a silver monkey statue with only 3 pieces.

tracks.title: Malt Shop Bop
tracks.description: 1950's era peppy rock piece with nice brushed drum work. Piano solo is sort of bluesy. Modulation.

tracks.title: Man Down
tracks.description: This is the Miami Nights main theme motive, but really quite sad. You know what's awesome? This "string synth" is 8 actual cellos and 12 violas... multi-tracked 4 times. Technology! So much power, you can't help but abuse it!

tracks.title: Mana Two - Part 1
tracks.description: Is nice? Is nice.

tracks.title: Mana Two - Part 2
tracks.description: You don't think mountains are timeless? What are you, a geologist? I should have recognized that by your customized beer mugs and your copper-colored Subaru.

tracks.title: Mana Two - Part 3
tracks.description: If clouds themselves hold the secret, then the secret must be moisture. Remember to hydrate!

tracks.title: Mandeville
tracks.description: Minor reggae groove with a cool triplet delay piano bit.

tracks.title: Manic Polka
tracks.description: Peppy.

tracks.title: Manor
tracks.description: This one is a little more peppy than the others in this video experience album. Still very very blippy, though. 9.7/10 on the blippiness scale.

tracks.title: Maple Leaf Rag
tracks.description: Scott Joplin composition.

tracks.title: March of the Mind
tracks.description: Slightly disconcerting, while retaining some lightness.

tracks.title: March of the Spoons
tracks.instruments: Bass Clarinet, Basses, Cellos, Violas, Violins, Flutes, Clarinets, Oboes, Drums
tracks.description: How can you tell if a piece of music is intended to be comedic? Pizzicato strings and a bass clarinet! This piece has it all! Pizzicato strings? Check! Bass clarinet? You bet! Throw in some staccato high winds and you got yourself a great comedic piece! Going out on a date and want to appear more entertaining? Bring a bass clarinet! Bass clarinet players I think also get discounts at T.G.I.Fridays; Double bonus!

tracks.title: Mariachi Snooze
tracks.instruments: Trumpets, Kit, Guitar, Marimba, Glock, Bass
tracks.description: A very light little intro-type piece with a cut-out in the middle for voice-overs.

tracks.title: Martian Cowboy
tracks.description: Slow-moving synth textures. Glock starts at about 1:20, and the bass at 1:50

tracks.title: Marty Gots a Plan
tracks.instruments: Cello, Viola, Violin, English Horn, Alto Flute, Percussion, Marimba
tracks.description: Sneaking around the house? Use this! Planning a comedic caper? Also good! Semi-random pizzicato is like magic for cheeky hijinks. You know... when Marty gots a plan, it aint usually a good one.

tracks.title: Mary Celeste
tracks.instruments: Tuba, Bass Clarinet, French Horns, Contra Bassoon, Bass Flute, Flutes, Clarinets, Oboe, Marimba, Tubular Bells, Cellos, Violins, Violas
tracks.description: Dark and broody, this one starts thin, gets really muddy, and then releases to a faster clearer section. Where would I use this? No idea. I'm sure you'll think of something, though!

tracks.title: Master Disorder
tracks.description: Sometimes you do things with little expectation of how it is going to finally turn out. Maybe you're making a hummus and cauliflower pizza roll... Will it work? Who knows! You can sort of make the hummus taste like Italian hummus if you use enough oregano, basil, and... chili flakes or something. So, then you make it, and realize it should be called a "Flaccid Spiced Hummus Ball". Eating a flaccid spiced hummus ball helps to assess your life choices... that eventually led you to eating a flaccid spiced hummus ball.  Uncompressed download comes in 4 speeds; 72, 80 (this one), 88, and 96 beats per minute. Flaccid spiced hummus ball.

tracks.title: Master of the Feast
tracks.instruments: Crumhorns, Lute, Guitar, Zither, Flute, Percussion
tracks.description: Old time party music... like REALLY old time party music.

tracks.title: Matt's Blues
tracks.description: Nice Americana blues. Courtesy GarageBand... with some help.

tracks.title: Meanwhile in Bavaria
tracks.description: Technically, it isn't a polka - though you can certainly dance to it. This recording is perfect for all your Octoberfest needs!

tracks.title: Measured Paces
tracks.description: Slow and measured quiet pulsing piano. For that "something is going on... and it probably won't be good" feel.

tracks.title: Meatball Parade
tracks.description: Fast paced, funny, and downright delightful! If you haven't heard this.... seriously take a listen. I'm a big fan of this piece. I get a lot of requests for things like "Yakity Sax", but there isn't really a way to do that without just ripping the piece off. Hopefully, this is enough fun!

tracks.title: Mechanolith
tracks.description: Superlatives abound in this giant orchestral/industrial piece. To be played loud. From the original soundtrack to "The Last Stand of the Mechanolith".

tracks.title: Meditation Impromptu 01
tracks.description: A single piano impromptu in D flat Major, broken into three files for easier downloading. This piece was made because many people were using my music as background for hypnosis and meditation products. This is a very very calming (and long) piano piece designed for just that. There is nothing startling contained in this piece... only light flowing melodies.

tracks.title: Meditation Impromptu 02
tracks.description: A single piano impromptu in D flat Major, broken into three files for easier downloading. This piece was made because many people were using my music as background for hypnosis and meditation products. This is a very very calming (and long) piano piece designed for just that. There is nothing startling contained in this piece... only light flowing melodies.

tracks.title: Meditation Impromptu 03
tracks.description: A single piano impromptu in D flat Major, broken into three files for easier downloading. This piece was made because many people were using my music as background for hypnosis and meditation products. This is a very very calming (and long) piano piece designed for just that. There is nothing startling contained in this piece... only light flowing melodies.

tracks.title: Medusa
tracks.description: Crazy dark and intense, this piece has a ton of atmosphere, and subtle digital effects. See also: Steel and Seething

tracks.title: Mega Hyper Ultrastorm
tracks.description: Player One Up! Ready! Go! Health 100%. Weasel Gun Equipped. This is sort of how I imagined 80s electronic music people tried to copy the distorted guitars of the day, but with 8bit sound sources. It doesn't sound like guitars at all, but it does sound like people trying to sound like guitars... and that's a thing now.

tracks.title: Mellowtron
tracks.description: Mid-90s styled video game music.

tracks.title: Melodie Victoria
tracks.description: Ragtime-like music box theme with an unexpected-sounding bridge section.

tracks.title: Memory Lane
tracks.description: Casual, quiet piano solo for those introspective moments. 3/4

tracks.title: Merry Go
tracks.description: Comedic and playful, this rag-time ditty has a strong melody, and is heavy in the bass chords. The second minute features flighty finger-work, as if an energetic bee is flying up and down the scales. The last thirty seconds is a refrain of the introduction, and the piece ends with an invigorating flourish.

tracks.description: Comedic and playful, this rag-time ditty has a strong melody, and is heavy in the bass chords. The second minute features flighty finger-work, as if an energetic bee is flying up and down the scales. The last thirty seconds is a refrain of the introduction, and the piece ends with an invigorating flourish.

The last thirty seconds is a refrain of the introduction, and the piece ends with an invigorating flourish.

The second minute features flighty finger-work, as if an energetic bee is flying up and down the scales. The last thirty seconds is a refrain of the introduction, and the piece ends with an invigorating flourish.

tracks.title: Mesmerize
tracks.description: Need to suck someone in? This piece never quite gives what you want.... so you just get sucked in. Perfect for videos like: Disassembling a watch, Removing a giant zit, Drilling a hole in a glacier, or anything that takes just a little longer than most people think it should.

tracks.title: Mesmerizing Galaxy
tracks.description:
This piece was written for a 2d-bullet-hell space shooter. It loops seamlessly to allow variable-length gameplay. There is no percussion because of all the explosions in the game itself. The piece probably has some utility beyond bullet-hell; paranormal investigation comes to mind. If you are doing paranormal investigations, I would like to see the following shows: 
 -"Ghosts of the Galaxy"
 -"The Otherworld Unit"
 -"Whispers from the Unknown"
 -"Unearthly Encounters"
 -"Phantom Photons"
These would also make excellent science/astronomy shows.

tracks.title: Metalmania
tracks.description: I was doing some research on metal... today's description is going to involve some participation on your part. Step 1) Google: "Death Metal English" the first link should be from invisibleoranges. Step 2) Enjoy!  You're welcome.

tracks.title: Metaphysik
tracks.instruments: Violins, Violas, Cellos, Basses, Piano, Synth
tracks.description: Slow, odd, and gosh-darned beautiful! There's a lot of subtle droniness and reverses. Maybe something supernatural here? There is certainly some things that aren't right about it.

tracks.title: Miami Nights - Extended Theme
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Synths, Tenor Sax, Trumpet, Drums, Strings
tracks.description: Did you ever wake up one day and think, "I should write an entire soundtrack treatment for a reboot of an early 90s tv action-drama that will probably never get produced!" Of course you didn't. No worries. I got you. If they do reboot "Miami Vice," I want to capture the crappy synthetic feel of the era, but with more natural sound. There are drum machines in here that were placed on a stage, put through amps, recorded on microphones, then digitally processed to sound more like drum machines. You’re welcome.

tracks.title: Miami Viceroy
tracks.description: Musical wallpaper! You might think that's a bad thing, but it quite useful for playing under interviews, or during countdowns, or in really hip cafes where you can get an Americano (coffee) or an Americano (Campari+vermouth cocktail). Life Pro Tip: ALWAYS refrigerate your vermouth! It is a wine product and will go bad if open at room temperature. So, to all of you who "hate vermouth", no - you hate ruined vermouth. Just like anyone who has only had room temperature red wine that's been opened for 3 weeks would hate wine.

tracks.title: Midday Dance
tracks.description: Impromptu piano solo with a strange little bounce rhythm. Catchy, and slightly "off". Ends on a fat rich chord.

tracks.title: Midnight Meeting
tracks.description: Pipe organ mini-fuge.

tracks.title: Midnight Tale
tracks.description: Gather 'round the tavern's fire and I will share a tale for as long as I have ale. Hah! "Tale and ale!" I'm not guaranteeing rhymes, though. That was a coincidence. I was playing lute for an uninterested group of tavern-goers, when all of a sudden, I remembered that I had a sandwich for lunch! It looks like I'm out of ale, so that is the end of my tale.

tracks.title: Midsummer Sky
tracks.description: Solo new-age piano.

tracks.title: Mighty and Meek
tracks.instruments: Trumpets, Trombones, Horns, Tubas, Oboe, Bassoon, Clarinet, Flutes, Tympani, Snare, Percussion, Strings
tracks.description: An epic piece involving lots of parallel chordal movement.  All Horns throughout. Trumpets used mainly for the fanfare type bits.

tracks.title: Mighty Like Us
tracks.description: Only 6 monophonic synths and a drum set in this entire, extremely peppy, undeniably enthusiastic, off-kilter, oddly satisfying electronic piece! Even at that, it gets pretty dense near the end.   Try this one! You'll like it! (you'll probably like it... figure about 90 percent guaranteed to like this piece by the end.) The uncompressed download comes with a mix done using electronic drums. It has a very different and more machine-like feel. Chances you'll like that one are lower... but it is totally usable for a harsher feel.

tracks.title: Militaire Electronic
tracks.description: Snare line with quads and a bass line add marching flair for an electronic groove.

tracks.title: Mind Scrape
tracks.description: Interesting collection of consonant and dissonant sounds across the spectrum of sound.

tracks.title: Minima
tracks.instruments: Trumpets, Trombones, Horns, Clarinet, Flute, Oboe, Bassoon, Contra Bassoon, Bass Clarinet, Contrabass Clarinet, Percussion, Celesta, Cellos, Basses, Violins, Choir, Tympani
tracks.description:
The orchestra is woodwind-heavy, it is actually low-winds-heavy so You've got a lot of Contrabass Clarinet,  Bass Clarinet, Contra Bassoon, Bassoon... And they're just pulsing... Pulsing and pulsing and pulsing.
 So what do you use this for? I don't know. Some things that aren't quite real. It's not a very real-sounding thing.

tracks.title: Mining by Moonlight
tracks.description: Light, upbeat, cool - useful for video game montages, and telephone on-hold music... and... nearly anything where you need something interesting - but not TOO interesting.

tracks.title: Minstrel Guild
tracks.description: Music from the 1400s or thereabouts. A quite lively little piece for your town or tavern.

tracks.title: Mirage
tracks.description: A sort of drone-based piece with something that sounds like a waterphone, and some other things that I don't know what they could be. Super chill - good amounts of tension with some glorious consonants.

tracks.title: Miri's Magic Dance
tracks.description: Eastern European folk-sounding dark, slowish dance.

tracks.title: Mischief Maker
tracks.description: Hey buddy, wanna buy a ferret? How about a trained ferret? Okay, I didn't really train her... she just has a predisposition to things. She stuffs squirrels into boxes, feeds them sugary treats and then empties the boxes though mailslots. Well, if you're not going to buy her, how about some nails... to keep your mailslot closed.

tracks.title: Mistake the Getaway
tracks.description: The chase begins with horn blasts, and the kit plays a solid beat while the bass strings are a pulsing drone below the horn melody. The piece grows more tense and emotional, the strings taking the lead and rise into a flowing intensity. Danger returns in full force as the music crescendos and return for one final push.

tracks.title: Mister Exposition
tracks.description: bubbly ragtime piano with an occasional tuba.

tracks.title: Misuse
tracks.description: Sort of a dark dance piece. Interesting things happen regularly.

tracks.title: Modern Jazz Samba
tracks.instruments: Kit, Bass, Acoustic Guitar, Piano, Flute
tracks.description: A nice little 85 BMP piece with guitar, piano, bass, and flute. Kind of jazzy and slightly blues-y with a more rocking beat. The bass in this piece is actually a sample from an 18th century double bass. Most latin players aren't likely to be on one of these... but it was the only one I had at the time.

tracks.title: Modern Vibes
tracks.description: Modern Vibraphone composition. 4 mallet, plays with rhythm over the entire range of the instrument.

tracks.title: Monkeys Spinning Monkeys
tracks.description: Loopable happy light fluffy piece with bright flutes and a bunch of pizzicato strings.

tracks.title: Monkoto
tracks.description: Clashing time signatures, but a cohesive piece.

tracks.title: Monster Promenade
tracks.description: "What a fun harmonic rollercoaster on the new tune!" Reminiscent of a carnival, this is an intentionally clashing harmonic piece... yet somehow very fun and quirky.

tracks.title: Montauk Point
tracks.description: Unobtrusive simple guitar, bass, drums combo.

tracks.title: Montego
tracks.description: Modern yet classic reggae piece. Starts with a classic video game riff.

tracks.title: Moon Lounge Omicron Prime
tracks.description: Okay, not quite a synth, not quite and organ - that thing is a mellotron. And it is cool. Interesting baroque changes in the B section. General Space-age cocktail party awesomeness for the entire piece.

tracks.title: Moonlight Beach
tracks.description: Bare bones island vibe without all the excitement and thrills. At about 2 and a half minutes in, it gets even less exciting! The mallet rolls are pretty good though. I used an EM1 Malletstation and real mallets. Makes a difference.

tracks.title: Moonlight Hall
tracks.instruments: Celesta, Tuba, Choir, Oboe, Bassoon, Violins, Violas, Cellos, Basses, Flute, Piccolo, Tympani, Percussion
tracks.description: 6/8 Starts nice, Ends frantic. The original melody was written to be performed on a Viol de Gamba... but I moved it over to oboe.

tracks.title: Moonstone
tracks.description: Calm sort of piece played all and only on the black keys.

tracks.title: Moorland
tracks.description: It has Uilleann pipes, and is dark and somber. Not sure what else I can say about this.

tracks.title: Morgana Rides
tracks.description: This is dark and concerning - like the lights-out bonus level on your hidden object game. Almost exactly like that. As if it was written for the dark bonus level of a hidden object game. Just as if.

tracks.title: Morning
tracks.description:
Morning. The time of day when you can’t figure out how to get to your drive-thru coffee place because there’s new construction and the sun is super low, so you’re squinting at the signs, trying to figure out if you are supposed to turn left here or if you definitely should NOT turn left here, because you will get three tires shredded by sharp, metal chunks before you fall in a hole. 

This piece of music is based on the old-timey concept of calm, beautiful, renewing mornings.

tracks.title: Motherlode
tracks.instruments: guitars, bass, drums, french horn, trumpet
tracks.description: Big broad sound certain to give a sense of rockin' wonder! It switches back and forth between  faster guitar-driven sections and majestic horn sections. I know - it sounds like it won't work, but it totally DOES work. Just imagine motocross highlights to this! Or any extreme sport that would benefit from the use of slow motion.

tracks.title: Motivator
tracks.description: Classic style corporate-presentation rock piece.

tracks.title: Mountain Emperor
tracks.description: So many big drums! All the big drums in all one place! Bonus; Extra people banging on gamelan metals! Uncompressed download comes with a version with just the drums... I'm not sure if this of for non-musicologists who may not like the gamelan - or specifically for musicologists who think I've used the gamelan improperly.

tracks.title: Mourning Song
tracks.description: Long broad notes with a solo oboe.

tracks.title: Move Forward
tracks.description: Mid-90s styled happy happy video game music.

tracks.title: Movement Proposition
tracks.feel: Action, Aggressive, Driving, Epic, Grooving, Intense
tracks.description: Fight scenes and chase scenes. Also good for high energy magic shows.

tracks.title: Mr. Mealey's Mediocre Machine
tracks.description: Quirky light piece played lightly.

tracks.title: MTA
tracks.description: Urban-sounding tight piece suitable for rap or stand-alone. Some giant hits, and a cool B section in here. Mix consultant: Bryan Teoh.

tracks.title: Music Box Theme
tracks.description: Very simple theme voiced in very very high and bright registers.

tracks.title: Music for Funeral Home - Part 11
tracks.description: This piece works very well for an actual funeral home setting, or any solemn event. The organ is light and flutey, the chords are often meandering, but have some closure now and then. There are 11 parts in this series - totaling about 34 minutes.

tracks.title: Music for Manatees
tracks.description: Beautiful slow moving piece with consonant sounds punctuated by rare notes that sing out over the top... like the manatee.

tracks.title: Music to Delight
tracks.instruments: Whistle, Bass, Guitar, Wood Blocks, Tambourine, Clapping
tracks.description: Oh, unclassifiable... this almost makes a mockery of other unclassifiable things. The woodblock player is solid. The tambourine player... not so much. Tin whistle player is delightful!

tracks.title: Myst
tracks.instruments: Oboe, Trombones, Clarinet, Percussion, Strings, Choir, Flute
tracks.description: Theme from "AngloZulu" expanded on, but in a more relaxed sense.

tracks.title: Myst on the Moor
tracks.description: Could be the thinking music for a quiz show about the paranormal? "Where does the Sasquatch typically vacation... is it A, The High Mountains... B, Unexplored Cave Systems...  C, Graceland... or D, In another dimension - similar to, but not strongly coupled with our own reality. Take your time and answer whenever you're ready.... A, B, C, or D... Would you like to consult the Tarot or do an entrail reading?" I love the flute bits in this piece.

tracks.title: Mysterioso March
tracks.instruments: Orchestral - Celesta, Bass, Pizz, Bass Clarinet, Percussion, Horn, Clarinet, Trumpet
tracks.description: Ponderous and slightly creepy.

tracks.title: Mystery Bazaar
tracks.description: Well met, traveller! Come warm by my brazier... Is that a Djinn in your pocket, or are you just happy to see me? Hah! I have a joke with you! ...unless it is a djinn - then you must leave immediately! ...unless that would offend the djinn - then you must stay! ...unless the djinn is going to kill me - then you must leave immediately! ...unless it will save me from a fate worse than death - then you must stay! Oh good... it was an erection. Uncompressed download comes with a faster version.

tracks.title: Mystery Sax
tracks.description: Holy smoldering tenor sax, Batman!! You want to set a mood? This is your track! It just keeps building and building! The sheet music for this recording is a post-it that says "noodle in F Minor." Such is the power of a real musician! You can just give them notes like that... and get music like this!

tracks.title: Mystery Sting
tracks.description: Slow groove percussion under an exotic melody.

tracks.title: Mystery!
tracks.description: Theme song for a 1940's style radio show. Organs, brass, and bells with effects to increase the "age". Run time is closer to one minute without the record scratches.

tracks.title: Mystic Force
tracks.description: Vaguely exotic sounding, yet still comfortably tonal, this piece certainly falls between some cracks. Gamelan is listed as an instrument... but that's sort of like listing an orchestra as an instrument... which I sometimes do. The other thing in here is that helicon. Imagine you take a french horn (which is like 5 meters of tubes) and make it even bigger! I guess it is also the name of a mountain in Greece? I did not use the mountain in this piece.

tracks.title: Nano Hoedown
tracks.description: When circuits throw a party, I imagine it sounds something like this. They can be a bit hyperactive at times. The super download comes with a more calm version at 120 beats per minute, and a crazy fast version at 180 beats per minute! All three versions loop perfectly, so you can make this as long as you need it!

tracks.title: Naraina
tracks.description: Somewhere between Bollywood and club music.

tracks.title: Neo Western
tracks.description: Big drums and an exposed 'western-style' electric guitar. Lots of drums.

tracks.title: Neolith
tracks.description: Aggressive guitars in 2 styles. The guitar mostly in the right channel has a hard gate effect on eighth notes, giving it an almost percussive drive. The one on the left is extended power chords with a hint of a major mode to them - as opposed to the traditional unqualified (open root fifth) or minor chords that you usually find in hard rock pieces. The effect is striking at times.

tracks.title: Neon Laser Horizon
tracks.description: Build your pyramid in Five easy steps! 1) Level the intended build site 2) Get your GED in architecture 3) Quarry 100 million tons of limestone from a local quarry (cubits?) 4) Learn to be a charismatic leader 5) Synergize your assets from steps 3 and 4. Congratulations, you are on your way to pyramid success! Ask about our supplementary obelisk pamphlet!

tracks.title: Nerves
tracks.feel: Action, Dark, Eerie, Epic, Intense, Suspenseful
tracks.description: The first two minutes contain many changes and shifts in tone - all intense.  The final minute is a collection of all that came before, ending in a pulse-quickening finale. This is music for an action film, or a scene that begins with tremulous anxiety and ends in a big way.

tracks.title: Nervous
tracks.description: Background horror music. Solo piano; high and out of tune.

tracks.title: Netherworld Shanty
tracks.instruments: Accordion, Tin Whistle, Kalimba, Percussion, Bassoon, Synths
tracks.description: A happy little discordant march with a catchy melody.

tracks.title: New Direction
tracks.description: A calm ambient piece using the "Trope" synth for iPhone and some miscellaneous Logic synths.

tracks.title: New Friendly
tracks.description: The piece starts out nice, and then becomes a modulating monster about a minute in. It resolves to the initial key, and continues on. Lots of building! Very round-sounding.

tracks.title: New Hero in Town
tracks.description: An epic hero has arrived. Notice has been given.

tracks.title: Newer Wave
tracks.description: The 80s Gallop, a rhythmic motive heard in this piece, was popularized by many synth pop bands of yesteryear. Legend has it, some of those bands may still exist - wandering the countryside in search of slap bracelets.

tracks.title: News of Sorrow
tracks.description: African-influenced short piece with continuous accelerando.

tracks.title: News Theme
tracks.description: Big, Bold, piece suitable for news themes or the like.  Starts off with a Horns, which then continue throughout.  Fades out quickly. The Whip (Extended Version)

tracks.title: NewsSting
tracks.description: Your favorite news channel from 10 years ago.

tracks.title: Night Break
tracks.description: Edgy-sounding synths with several pulsing band-pass sweeps.

tracks.title: Night Cave
tracks.description: Loose groove with a nice active bell part, and an overloud kalimba.

tracks.title: Night in Venice
tracks.instruments: Alto Sax, Electric Piano, Bass, Drums
tracks.description: Just your run of the mill nice jazz; processed to sound a lot older than it is.

tracks.title: Night of Chaos
tracks.description: The mellow guitar lulls you on a superficial level, while being undermined by the synths.

tracks.title: Night of the Owl
tracks.description: Native American drumming with a flute.

tracks.title: Night on the Docks - Piano
tracks.description: Sad and smooth; Think 1950's detective film.

tracks.title: Night on the Docks - Sax
tracks.description: Sad and smooth; Think 1950's detective film.

tracks.title: Night on the Docks - Trumpet
tracks.description: Sad and smooth; Think 1950's detective film.

tracks.title: Night Vigil
tracks.description: This piece gives me the feels. Remember that episode in Game of Thrones where the dead were coming to Winterfell, but they'd be there later... so everyone is just waiting. Cleaning the horses, eating cold soup, hugging friends, stacking wood. There is deep sadness in there. That's this piece.

tracks.title: Nightdreams
tracks.description: Are you still spending all of your money on shakra therapies that don't seem to work? Look no further - Nightdreams will do everything those therapies do and at a much lower cost! Presence is the truth of well-being. And no one can argue that to be well, one must first exist. Before you start listening to this piece, make certain that you exist. No one needs another one of those 'tree-falling paradoxes' messing up their lives... or their forests.

tracks.title: Nightmare Machine
tracks.description: This piece shares a bassline with "Eternal Terminal" (found elsewhere on this site). It also has the same waterphone. You can use these 2 pieces together and make it seem like your project had a custom composer! How cool is that!?

tracks.title: Nile's Blues
tracks.description: Slow blues in 6/8. Tasty.

tracks.title: No Frills Comparsa
tracks.instruments: Kit, Bass, Electric Guitar, Piano, Flute, Bari Sax, Tenor Sax, Trumpet
tracks.description: A basic comparsa.

tracks.title: No Frills Cumbia
tracks.instruments: Kit, Bass, Acoustic Guitar, Piano, Organ, Flute
tracks.description: A basic cumbia.

tracks.title: No Frills Cumbia
tracks.instruments: Kit, Bass, Acoustic Guitar, Piano, Organ, Flute
tracks.description: A fast cumbia.

tracks.title: No Frills Salsa
tracks.description: Basic Salsa.

tracks.title: No Frills Salsa - Alternate
tracks.description: Basic Salsa.

tracks.title: No Good Layabout
tracks.description: Mid-tempo walking bass, piano, and drums with a clarinet solo in the middle.

tracks.title: No Spam Polka
tracks.description: Very happy.

tracks.title: Noble Race
